segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma inna hadhayni ÄyatÄni min ÄyÄtika,
segments.translation: O Allah! Indeed these two are among Your signs,
And these two are among Your helpers,

segments.arabic: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَةٍ نَافِعَةٍ أَوْ نِقْمَةٍ ضَارَّةٍ،
segments.transliteration: YabtadirÄni á¹­Äâataka biraá¸¥matin nÄfiâatin aw niqmatin á¸Ärratin,
segments.translation: They hasten to obey You, bringing either helpful mercy or harmful punishment,
So do not pour upon us their evil rain,
And do not clothe us with affliction through them.
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segments.transliteration: Wa anzil âalaynÄ nafâa hÄdhihi as-saá¸¥Äâibi wa barakatahÄ,
segments.translation: And send down upon us the benefit and blessing of these clouds,
And turn away from us their harm and damage,
And do not strike us with calamity through them,
And do not send blight upon our livelihoods.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نِقْمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa in kunta baâathtahÄ niqmah wa arsaltahÄ sakhta,
segments.translation: O Allah, if You have sent them as a punishment and anger,
Then we seek refuge in You from Your anger,

segments.transliteration: Wa nabtahilu ilayka fÄ« suâÄli âafwika,
segments.translation: And we implore You in asking for Your pardon,
So direct Your anger towards the polytheists,

segments.transliteration: Wa adir raá¸¥Ä niqmatika âalÄ al-mulá¸¥idÄ«n,
segments.translation: And turn the mill of Your punishment upon the disbelievers.
O Allah, remove the drought of our land with Your rain,
And bring out the burning of our hearts with Your provision,
And do not distract us from You with anything else,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: WalÄ taqá¹­aâ âan kÄffatinÄ mÄddata birrik,
segments.translation: And do not cut off from us the flow of Your goodness,
For the truly rich is the one whom You enrich,
And the safe one is the one You protect,
No one besides You has defense,
And no one can resist Your might,

segments.arabic: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segments.transliteration: Taá¸¥kumu bimÄ shiâta âalÄ man shiâta,
segments.translation: You judge as You will over whom You will,

segments.transliteration: Wataqá¸Ä« bimÄ aradta fÄ« man aradta,
segments.translation: And You decree as You wish upon whom You wish.

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segments.transliteration: Falaka al-á¸¥amdu âalÄ mÄ waqaytanÄ minal-balÄâ,
segments.translation: So praise is Yours for protecting us from affliction,

segments.arabic: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النِّعْمَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Walaka ash-shukru âalÄ mÄ khawwaltanÄ minan-niâmÄâ,
segments.translation: And thanks are Yours for what You granted us of blessings,
A praise that surpasses the praise of those who praise,
A praise that fills His earth and His heaven,
Surely, You are the Bestower of immense favors,
The Giver of great blessings,
The Accepter of even little praise,
The Thankful for even little gratitude,
The Beneficent, the Generous, the Possessor of bounty,

segments.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segments.transliteration: LÄ ilÄha illÄ anta ilayka al-maá¹£Ä«r,
segments.translation: There is no god but You; to You is the return.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-na hd'ay-ni aaayataani min aaayaatik
segments.translation: 1.O God, these are two of Your signs
2.and these are two of Your helpers.

segments.arabic: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَة نَافِعَة أَوْ نَقِمَة ضَارَّة،
segments.transliteration: yab-tadiraani t'aaa'taka birah'-matin-naafia'tin aw naqimatin z''aaar-rah
segments.translation: 3.They rush to obey You with beneficial mercy or injurious vengeance,
4.so rain not down upon us from them the evil rain
5.and clothe us not through them in the garment of affliction!
6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa anzil a'lay-naa naf-a' had'ihs-sah'aaa-ibi wa barakatahaa
segments.translation: 7.send down upon us the benefit of these clouds and their blessing,
8.turn away from us their harm and their injury,
9.strike us not through them with blight,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tur-sil a'laa maa'ayishinaa a'ahah
segments.translation: 10.and loose not upon our livelihoods any bane!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نَقِمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa in kunta baa'th-tahaa naqimah wa ar-sal-tahaa sakh-t'ah
segments.translation: 11.O God, if You hast incited them as vengeance and loosed them in anger,
12.we seek sanctuary with You from Your wrath

segments.transliteration: wa nab-tahilu ilay-ka fee soo-aali a'f-wik
segments.translation: 13.and implore You in asking Your pardon!
14.So incline with wrath toward the idolaters
15.and set the millstone of Your vengeance turning upon the heretics
16.O God, take away the barrenness of our lands with Your watering,
17.dislodge the malice from our breasts with Your providing,
18.distract us not from You through other than You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taq-t'aa' a'n kaaaf-fatinaa maaad-data bir-rik
segments.translation: 19.and cut none of us off from the stuff of Your goodness,
20.for the rich is he to whom You hast given riches,
21.and the safe he whom You hast protected!
22.No one has any defense against You,

segments.transliteration: wa laa bih'adin a'n sat'-watika am-tinaaa'
segments.translation: 23.nor any means to bar Your penalty.

segments.arabic: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segments.transliteration: tah'-kumu bimaa shi-ta a'laa man shi-t
segments.translation: 24.You decidest what You wilt for whom You wilt

segments.transliteration: wa taq-z''ee bimaaa arat-ta fee man arat-t
segments.translation: 25.and You decreest what You desirest for any whom You desirest!

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segments.translation: 26.So to You belongs praise for protecting us from affliction

segments.arabic: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النّعْمَاءِ
segments.transliteration: wa lakash-shuk-ru a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanaa minan-naa'-maaa-i
segments.translation: 27.and to You belongs thanks for conferring upon us blessings,
28.a praise which will leave behind the praise of the praisers,
29.a praise which will fill the earth and the heaven!
30.Surely You art the All-kind through immense kindnesses,
31.the Giver of abounding favours,
32.the Accepter of small praise,
33.the Grateful for little gratitude,
34.the Beneficent, the Benevolent, Possessor of graciousness!

segments.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segments.translation: 35.There is no god but Thou; unto You is the homecoming

text: Ziyarat Lady Khadija - Wife of Holy Prophet - Duas.org       Ziyarat Khadija bint-e-Khawailad(sa) First and Most Beloved Wife of Holy Prophet(saw) Title : Umm-ul-Momineen / Tahira | Death 10th Ramadhan 3 years before Hijrah at the age of 64 years. | Buried in Makkah ( Jannatul Maala cemetry) Umm-ul-Momineen and mother of Syeda Fatima Zahra (sa) . segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ الْاَئِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ المُؤْمِنِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Ummal A-Immatit Taahereena - Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Ummal Momineena
segments.translation: Peace on you, O the mother of the pure Imams, Peace be on you, O the mother of the believing men
Peace be on you, O the first of the believing women
Peace be on you, O the sincere lady among the devoted ones

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَةَ الْحَرَمِ وَ مَلِكَةَ الْبَطْحَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Sayyedatal Harame Wa Malekatal Bathaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the chief lady of the sacrosanct (haram) And the queen of Mecca

segments.arabic: السَّلاَم عَلَيْكِ يَا اَوَّلَ مَنْ صَدَّقَتْ ِرَسُوْلِ اللهِ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Awwala Man Saddaqat Be Rasoolillaahe Menan Nesaaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the first one to believe in the Apostle of Allah from among the women

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ وَفَتْ بِالْعُبُوْدِيَّةِ حَقَّ الْوَفَاءِ وَ اَسْلَمَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَ اَنْفَقَتْ مَالَهَا لِسَيِّدِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Wafat Bil OâBoodiyyate Haqqal Wafaa-E Wa Aslamat Nafsahaa Wa Anfaqat Maalahaa Le Sayyedil Anbeyaaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one who observed servitude as it ought to be observed, submitted herself and discharged her wealth in the service of the chief of the Prophets.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا قَرِيْنَةَ حَبِيْبِ اِلٰهِ السَّمَآءِ الْمُزَّوَّجَةِ بِخُلاَصَةِ الْاَصْفِيَآءِ يَابْنَةَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ الْخَلِيْلِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Qareenata Habeebe Elaahis Samaaail Mozawwajate Be Kholaasatil Asfeyaaa-E  Yabnata Ibraahemal Khaleele
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the companion of the beloved of the Lord of the Heaven. The spouse of the epitome of the chosen ones. O the daughter of Ibraheem, the friend (of Allah)

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْهَا جَبْرَئِيْلُ وَ بَلَّغَ اِلَيْهَا
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Sallama AâLayhaa Jibraeelo Wa Ballagha Elayhas
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one to whom Jibraeel used to salute and used to convey to her
the salutations from Allah, the Majestic.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا حَافِظَةَ دِيْنِ اللهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the protector of the religion of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا نَاصِرَةَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the helper of the Apostle of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ تَوَلىَّ دَفْنَهَا رَسُوْلُ اللهِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Tawallaa Dafnahaa Rasoolilaahe
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one whose burial was arranged by the Apostle of Allah
and he entrusted her to the Mercy of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكِ حَبِيْبَةُ اللهِ وَ خِيَرَةَ اُمَّتِهِ وَ اَنَّ اللهَ
segments.transliteration: Ash-Hado Annake Habeebullaahe Wa Kheyarata Ummatehi Wa Annallaaha
segments.translation: I bear witness that you are esteemed near Allah

segments.arabic: جَعَلَكِ فِىْ مُسْتَقَرِّ رَحْمَتِهِ فِىْ قَصْرٍ مِّنَ الْيَاقُوْتِ
segments.translation: and the chosen one among His nation and that Allah has placed you in His Mercy

segments.arabic: وَ الْعِقْيَانِ فِىْ اَعْلٰى مَنَازِلِ الْجِنَانِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْكِ وَ رَحْمَةُ الله وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.transliteration: Fee Qasrin Menal Yaaqoote Wal EâQyaane Fee A-AâLaa Manaazelil Jenaane, Sallallaaho AâLayke Wa Rahmatullaahe Wa Barakaatohu
segments.translation: in a place built of ruby and in the highest grades of Paradise, May Allah send salutations upon you and His Mercy and Blessings .

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ فَاَغِثْنِى وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلٰى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى شَاْنِى كُلَّه
segments.transliteration:
Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoomu birahmatika astagheetho, fa-aghithni 
wa laa Takilni ila nafsee Tarfata Aynin abadan, wa as-lih Lee Shani kullahu
segments.translation: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help, so help me and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَا اللهُ يَا حَافِظُ يَا حَفِيظُ يَا رَقِيبُ
segments.transliteration: Ya Allaho Ya Haafizo Ya Hafizo Ya Raqeebo
segments.translation: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O God, O Preserver, O Guardian, O Watcher.
In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيكَ يَا خِيَرَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ خَيرَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khiyarata allahi wabna khiyaratihi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O choicest of Allah and son of His choicest.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful
and son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.
Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah
the doyenne of the women of the worlds.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ وَٱلْوِتْرَ ٱلْمَوْتُورَ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi walwitra almawtura
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance, and the unavenged so far.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلأَرْوَاحِ ٱلَّتِي حَلَّتْ بِفِنَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa `ala al-arwahi allati hallat bifina'ika
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon the souls that resided in your courtyard.

segments.arabic: عَلَيْكُمْ مِنِّي جَمِيعاً سَلاَمُ ٱللَّهِ أَبَداً
segments.translation: Peace of Allah be upon all of you from me forever

segments.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
segments.translation: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.
O Abu-`Abdullah,
unbearable is the sorrow
and excruciating and unbearable is the misfortune of you
for us and for all the people of Islam.
Excruciating and unbearable has been your misfortune

segments.arabic: فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ
segments.translation: in the heavens for all the inhabitants of the heavens.

segments.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً أَسَّسَتْ أَسَاسَ ٱلظُّلْمِ وَٱلْجَوْرِ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ
segments.transliteration: fala`ana allahu ummatan assasat asasa alzzulmi waljawri `alaykum ahla albayti
segments.translation: So, may Allah curse the people who laid the basis of persecution and wronging against you, O Members of the Household.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً دَفَعَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَقَامِكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan dafa`atkum `an maqamikum
segments.translation: May Allah curse the people who drove you away from your position

segments.arabic: وَأَزَالَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَرَاتِبِكُمُ ٱلَّتِي رَتَّبَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: wa azalatkum `an maratibikum allati rattabakum allahu fiha
segments.translation: and removed you away from your ranks that Allah has put you in.
May Allah curse the people who slew you.
May Allah curse those who paved the way for them to do so
and who made possible for them to fight against you.

segments.transliteration: bari'tu ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum
segments.translation: I repudiate them in the presence of Allah and You

segments.transliteration: wa min ashya`ihim wa atba`ihim wa awliya'ihim
segments.translation: and I repudiate their devotees, followers, and loyalists.
O Abu-`Abdullah,
I am at peace with those who are at peace with you

segments.arabic: وَحَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa harbun liman harabakum ila yawmi alqiyamati
segments.translation: and I am at war against those who have fought against you up to the Resurrection Day.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ آلَ زِيَادٍ وَآلَ مَرْوَانَ
segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ala ziyadin wa ala marwana
segments.translation: May Allah also curse the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan.

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu bani umayyata qatibatan
segments.translation: May Allah also curse the descendants of Umayyah altogether.
May Allah also curse the son of Marjanah.
May Allah also curse `Umar the son of Sa`d.
May Allah also curse Shimr.

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan asrajat wa aljamat
segments.translation: May Allah also curse the people who saddled up, gave reins to their horses,
and masked their faces in preparation for fighting against you.
May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
Extremely insufferable is my commiserations with you;

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي أَكْرَمَ مَقَامَكَ وَأَكْرَمَنِي بِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'as'alu allaha alladhi akrama maqamaka wa akramani bika
segments.translation: so, I beseech Allah Who has honored your position and honored me because of you
to endue me with the chance to avenge you

segments.arabic: مَعَ إِمَامٍ مَنْصُورٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: ma`a imamin mansurin min ahli bayti muhammadin
segments.translation: with a (Divinely) supported leader from the Household of Muhammad,
peace of Allah be upon him and his Household.
O Allah, (please) make me illustrious in Your sight

segments.arabic: بِٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: in the name of al-Husayn, peace be upon him, in this world and in the Hereafter.
O Abu-`Abdullah,

segments.arabic: إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَإِلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ
segments.transliteration: inni ataqarrabu ila allahi wa ila rasulihi
segments.translation: I do seek nearness to Allah, to His Messenger,

segments.transliteration: wa ila amiri almu'minina wa ila fatimata
segments.translation: to the Commander of the Faithful, to Fatimah,

segments.transliteration: wa ila alhasani wa ilayka bimuwalatika
segments.translation: to al-Hasan, and to you by means of loyalty to you
and by means of repudiation of those who fought against you
and incurred your hostility,

segments.arabic: وَبِٱلْبَرَاءَةِ مِمَّنْ أَسَّسَ أَسَاسَ ٱلظُّلْمِ وَٱلْجَوْرِ عَلَيْكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa bilbara'ati mimman assasa asasa alzzulmi waljawri `alaykum
segments.translation: and repudiation of those who laid the basis of persecution and wronging against you all.

segments.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi wa ila rasulihi)
segments.translation: I also repudiate, in the presence of Allah and His Messenger,
those who laid the basis of all that,
established their foundations on it,

segments.arabic: وَجَرَىٰ فِي ظُلْمِهِ وَجَوْرِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعلىٰ أَشْيَاعِكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa jara fi zulmihi wa jawrihi `alaykum wa `ala ashya`ikum
segments.translation: and continued in wronging and persecuting you and your adherents.

segments.transliteration: bari'tu ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum
segments.translation: In the presence of Allah and you all do I repudiate these.

segments.transliteration: wa ataqarrabu ila allahi thumma ilaykum
segments.translation: And I seek nearness to Allah and then to you all
by means of declaring loyalty to you and to your loyalists
and declaring repudiation of your enemies
and those who incur animosity of you

segments.transliteration: wa bilbara'ati min ashya`ihim wa atba`ihim
segments.translation: and repudiation of their adherents and followers.
I am verily at peace with those who have been at peace with you,
I am at war against those who fought against you,
loyalist to those who have been loyalist to you,
and enemy of those who have shown enmity towards you.
So, I beseech Allah Who has endued me with the honor of recognizing you
and recognizing your loyalists
and Who conferred upon me with repudiation of your enemies,

segments.arabic: أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مَعَكُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: an yaj`alani ma`akum fi alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: to include me with you in this world and in the Hereafter

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ يُثَبِّتَ لِي عِنْدَكُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ
segments.transliteration: wa an yuthabbita li `indakum qadama sidqin
segments.translation: and to make firm step of honesty for me with you
in this world and in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُهُ أَنْ يُبَلِّغَنِيَ ٱلْمَقَامَ ٱلْمَحْمُودَ لَكُمْ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: wa as'aluhu an yuballighani almaqama almahmuda lakum `inda allahi
segments.translation: I also beseech Him to make me attain the praiseworthy status that you enjoy with Allah
and to bestow upon me with the chance to take my own vengeance
with a leader of true guidance who is (Divinely) sustained
and expressing the truth from among you.
I also beseech Allah in your names
and in the name of the standing that you enjoy with Him
to recompense me for my commiserations for you
with the most favorite thing that He ever gives as compensation for misfortunes that has afflicted anyone.
(Your) misfortune has been so astounding
and so catastrophic for Islam
and for all the heavens and the entire earth.
O Allah, (please) make me in this situation of mine

segments.arabic: مِمَّنْ تَنَالُهُ مِنْكَ صَلَوَاتٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ
segments.transliteration: mimman tanaluhu minka salawatun wa rahmatun wa maghfiratun
segments.translation: one of those who receive blessings, mercy, and forgiveness from You.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ مَحْيَايَ مَحْيَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`al mahyaya mahya muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) make me live my lifetime in the same way as Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household lived

segments.transliteration: wa mamati mamata muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: and make me die on the same principles on which Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household died.
O Allah, this day
has been regarded as blessed day by the descendants of Umayyah
and by the son of the liver-eater woman,
the accursed and son of the accursed
by the tongue of You and by the tongue of Your Prophet,
Allah’s peace be upon him,
on every occasion and in every situation,

segments.arabic: وَقَفَ فِيهِ نَبِيُّكَ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.transliteration: waqafa fihi nabiyyuka salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: which Your Prophet, Allah’s peace be upon him, attended.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ وَمُعَاوِيَةَ وَيَزيدَ بْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma il`an aba sufyana wa mu`awiyata wa yazida bna mu`awiyata
segments.translation: O Allah, pour curses upon Abu-Sufyan, Mu`awiyah, and Yazid son of Mu`awiyah.
May Your curse be upon them incessantly and everlastingly.

segments.arabic: وَهٰذَا يَوْمٌ فَرِحَتْ بِهِ آلُ زِيَادٍ وَآلُ مَرْوَانَ
segments.transliteration: wa hadha yawmun farihat bihi alu ziyadin wa alu marwana
segments.translation: This is the day on which the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan gloated
because they had killed al-Husayn, Allah’s blessings be upon him.
So, O Allah, pour frequent curses upon them
and double for them the painful chastisement.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ فِي هٰذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni ataqarrabu ilayka fi hadha alyawmi
segments.translation: O Allah, I do seek nearness to You on this day,
on this occasion,
and on all the days of my lifetime,
by repudiating these and invoking Your curses upon them,

segments.transliteration: wa bilmuwalati linabiyyika wa ali nabiyyika
segments.translation: and by declaring loyalty to Your Prophet and Your Prophet’s Household,
peace be upon him and them.
O Allah, pour curses upon the foremost persecutor

segments.transliteration: zalama haqqa muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: who usurped the right of Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household
and the last follower who acceded to his deed.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنِ ٱلْعِصَابَةَ ٱلَّتِي جَاهَدَتِ ٱلْحُسَيْنَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma il`an al`isabata allati jahadat alhusayna
segments.translation: O Allah, pour curses upon the gang that struggled against al-Husayn

segments.transliteration: wa shaya`at wa baya`at wa taba`at `ala qatlihi
segments.translation: and who supported each other against him, paid homage to his enemies, and participated in slaying him.
O Allah, pour curses upon all of them.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah
and upon the souls that gathered in your courtyard.
Peace of Allah be upon you from me forever

segments.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
segments.translation: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَتِكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa la ja`alahu allahu akhira al`ahdi minni liziyaratikum
segments.translation: May Allah not cause this (visit) to be the last of my visit to you (all).
Peace be upon al-Husayn,
upon `Ali ibn al-Husayn,
upon the sons of al-Husayn,
and upon the companions of al-Husayn.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ خُصَّ أَنْتَ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ بِٱللَّعْنِ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: allahumma khussa anta awwala zalimin billa`ni minni
segments.translation: O Allah, pour special curses on the foremost persecutor
and begin with him first,
and then pour curses on the second, the third, and the fourth.
O Allah, curse Yazid fifthly,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْعَنْ عُبَيْدَ ٱللَّهِ بْنَ زِيَادٍ وَٱبْنَ مَرْجَانَةَ
segments.translation: and curse `Ubaydullah ibn Ziyad, the son of Marjanah,
`Umar ibn Sa`d, Shimr,

segments.arabic: وَآلَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ وَآلَ زِيَادٍ وَآلَ مَرْوَانَ
segments.transliteration: wa ala abi sufyana wa ala ziyadin wa ala marwana
segments.translation: the family of Abu-Sufyan, the family of Ziyad, and the family of Marwan
up to the Resurrection Day.
O Allah, all praise be to You;
the praise of those who thank You for their misfortunes.
All praise be to Allah for my great misfortune.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱرْزُقْنِي شَفَاعَةَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ يَوْمَ ٱلْوُرُودِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma irzuqni shafa`ata alhusayni yawma alwurudi
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) grant me the intercession of al-Husayn on the Day of Coming (to You)
and make for me with You a firm step of honesty
with al-Husayn and the companions of al-Husayn

segments.arabic: ٱلَّذينَ بَذَلُوٱ مُهَجَهُمْ دُونَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.translation: who sacrificed their souls in defense of al-Husayn, peace be upon him.

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 18 When Perils were repelled or Requests quickly granted

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma laka al-á¸¥amdu âalÄ á¸¥usni qaá¸Äâika,
segments.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise for the goodness of Your decree,
And for what You have averted from me of Your trials,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَجْعَلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: FalÄ tajâal á¸¥aáºáºÄ« min raá¸¥matika mÄ âajjalta lÄ« min âÄfiyatika,
segments.translation: So do not make my share of Your mercy what You hastened for me of well-being,

segments.arabic: فَأَكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-akÅ«na qad shaqÄ«tu bimÄ aá¸¥babtu wa-saâida ghayrÄ« bimÄ karihtu,
segments.translation: So that I may end up wretched through what I loved, while others are happy with what I disliked,

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa-in yakun mÄ áºaliltu fÄ«hi aw bitu fÄ«hi min hÄdhihi al-âÄfiyah,
segments.translation: And if what I spent my day or night in of this well-being,

segments.arabic: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاءٍ لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ وَوِزْرٍ لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ،
segments.transliteration: Bayna yaday balÄâin lÄ yanqaá¹­iâu wa-wizrin lÄ yartafiâu,
segments.translation: Is before a trial that does not cease, and a burden that does not lift,

segments.arabic: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنِّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ،
segments.transliteration: Faqaddim lÄ« mÄ akhkharta wa-akhkhir âannÄ« mÄ qaddamta,
segments.translation: Then advance for me what You have delayed, and delay from me what You have advanced,

segments.arabic: فَغَيْرُ كَثِيرٍ مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْفَنَاءُ وَغَيْرُ قَلِيلٍ مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْبَقَاءُ،
segments.transliteration: Faghayru kathÄ«rin mÄ âÄqibatuhu al-fanÄâ wa-ghayru qalÄ«lin mÄ âÄqibatuhu al-baqÄâ,
segments.translation: For what ends in perishing is not great, and what ends in lasting is not small,
And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
segments.translation: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for Your excellent accomplishment
2.and for Your trial which You hast turned away from me!

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَجْعَـلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: falaa taj-a'l h'az'-z'ee mir-rah'-matika maa a'j-jal-ta lee min a'afeeatika
segments.translation: 3.But make not my share of Your mercy the well-being which You hast quickly granted to me,

segments.arabic: فَأكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
segments.transliteration: faakoona qad- shaqeetu bimaaa ah'-bab-t wa sai'da ghay-ree bimaa karih-t
segments.translation: 4.lest I become wretched through what I have loved and someone else gain felicity through what I have disliked!

segments.arabic: وَإنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa ee-yakum-maa z'alil-tu feeheee aw bit-tu feehee min had'ihil-a'afeeah
segments.translation: 5.If this well-being in which I pass the day or night

segments.arabic: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاء لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ، وَوِزْر لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ
segments.transliteration: bay-na yaday balaaa-il-laa yanqat'ia'- wa wiz-ril-laa yar-tafia'-
segments.translation: 6.should precede a trial that does not cease and a burden that does not pass away,

segments.arabic: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ
segments.transliteration: faqad-dim lee maaa akh-khar-t wa akh-khir a'n-nee maa qad-dam-t
segments.translation: 7.then set before me what You hadst set behind and set behind me what You hadst set before!
8.For that which ends in annihilation is not great
9.and that which ends in subsistence is not little.
10.And bless Muhammad and his Household!

title: Duas for Protection from Distress,Grief and Fear
text: Duas for Protection from Distress,Grief and Fear       Duas for Protection from Distress,Grief and Fear . Duas Baqiyatus-Salehat 1-6 Baq-Salehat 7-12 BqSl- Salats Etiquettes --> Arabic Transliteration Translation Sahifa Sajjadia dua no 50 in fear Dua Itisam in fear Duas for Worries and Hardships This page content Imam Ali (as) Prayer seeking relief Imam Jawad (as) Prayer release from Ordeals Syeda Fatima (sa) supplications after ritual Prayer seeking relief Shaykh al-Kaf`ami, in al-Balad al-Amin, has mentioned a prayer that is reported from Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (as) saying that no grief-stricken, worried, depressed, distressed, or aggrieved person recites it but that Almighty Allah will certainly take the edge off him. ÙÙØ§ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙ Ù±ÙØ¶ÙÙØ¹ÙÙÙØ§Ø¡Ù ya `awna alddu`afa'i O Helper of the weak! ÙÙØ§ ÙÙÙÙØ²Ù Ù±ÙÙÙÙÙÙØ±Ù

segments.arabic: يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لاَ عِمَادَ لَهُ
segments.translation: O Support of him who lacks support!

segments.arabic: ويَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لاَ ذُخْرَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ya dhukhra man la dhukhra lahu
segments.translation: O  protector of him who has no other

segments.arabic: وَيَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لاَ سَنَدَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ya sanada man lasanada lahu
segments.translation: O Prop of him who lacks prop!

segments.arabic: ويَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لاَ حِرْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ya hirza man la hirza lahu
segments.translation: O Shelter of him who lacks shelter!

segments.arabic: وَيَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لاَ غِيَاثَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ya ghiyatha man la ghiyatha lahu
segments.translation: O Aid of him who is aidless!

segments.arabic: وَيَا كَنْزَ مَنْ لاَ كَنْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yakanza man la kanza lahu
segments.translation: O Treasure of him who has no treasure!

segments.arabic: وَيَا عِزَّ مَنْ لاَ عِزَّ لَهُ
segments.translation: O Might of him who wants might!
O He Who pardons generously!
O He Who overlooks excellently!
O Helper of the weak!
O Treasure of the poor!
O He Who is greatly hoped!
O Savior of the drowned!
O Rescuer of the perishing!
O All-munificent! O All- benign!
O All-gracious! O All-benevolent!

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱلَّذِي سَجَدَ لَكَ سَوَادُ ٱللَّيْلِ وَنُورُ ٱلنَّهَارِ
segments.transliteration: anta alladhi sajada laka sawadu allayli wa nuru alnnahari
segments.translation: It is You alone before Whom the darkness of night has prostrated. So have the light of day,

segments.transliteration: wa daw'u alqamari wa shu`a`u alshshamsi
segments.translation: the brightness of the moon, the radiance of the sun,

segments.transliteration: wa hafifu alshshajari wa dawiyyu alma'i
segments.translation: the rustle of trees, and the murmur of water.

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
segments.translation: O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
There is no god save You;
You are the One and Only without having any partner.
O my Lord! O Allah!
(Please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and do to us all that which suits You.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَكْفِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man yakfi min kulli shay'in
segments.translation: O He Who protects against all things
while nothing can ever stand against Him,
(please do) save me from that which has aggrieved me.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
O God, I turn to You through the mediation of Muhammad and Progeny of Muhammad
and I adjure by that right of theirs,
whose reality is not known to anyone, except You.

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ مَنْ حَقُّهٗ عِنْدَكَ عَظِيْمٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa behaqqe man haqqohu iândaka aâzeemun,
segments.translation: And I adjure by the rights of those,

segments.arabic: وَ بِاَسْمَائِكَ الْحُسْنٰى وَ كَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِيْ اَمَرْتَنِيْ اَنْ اَدْعُوَكَ بِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa be-asmaa-ekal husnaa wa kalemaatekat taammaatil latee amartanee an ad-oâoka behaa,
segments.translation: whose right is great in your view and I adjure by your beautiful names and the perfect words through which You have commanded us to supplicate.

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِيْ اَمَرْتَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ - ؑ - اَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهِ الطَّيْرَ فَاَجَابَتْهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa as-aloka bismekal aâzeemil lazee amarta ibraaheema â aâlayhis salaamo â an yad-oâwa behit tayra fa-ajaabatho.
segments.translation: And I adjure You by that name through which You commanded Ibrahim Khaleel to call the dead birds.

segments.arabic: وَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِيْ قُلْتَ لِلنَّارِكُوْنِيْ بَرْدًا وَ سَلَامًا عَلٰى‏ اِبْراهِيْمَ فَكَانَتْ،
segments.transliteration: wa bismekal aâzeemil lazee qulta lin-naare koonee bardan wa salaaman aâlaa ibraaheema fakaanat,
segments.translation: And by that great name, which You blew on fire and made it cool and safe.

segments.arabic: وَ بِاَحَبِّ اَسْمَائِكَ اِلَيْكَ، وَ اَشْرَفِهَا عِنْدَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa be-ahabbe asmaaeka elayka, wa ashrafehaa iândaka
segments.translation: And by your most loved, noble and great names,

segments.arabic: وَ اَعْظَمِهَا لَدَيْكَ وَ اَسْرَعِهَا اِجَابَةً، وَ اَنْجَحِهَا طَلِبَةً،
segments.transliteration: wa a-aâzamehaa ladayka wa asra-eâhaa ejaabatan,wa anjahehaa talebatan
segments.translation: through which supplication is accepted immediately and needs are fulfilled

segments.arabic: وَ بِمَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهٗ وَ مُسْتَحِقُّهٗ وَ مُسْتَوْجِبُهٗ.
segments.transliteration: wa bemaa anta ahlohu wa mustahiqqohu wa mustawjebohu.
segments.translation: and which You are deserving of and owner of.

segments.arabic: وَ اَتَوَسَّلُ اِلَيْكَ، وَ اَرْغَبُ اِلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa atawassalo elayka, wa arghabo elayka,
segments.translation: I seek mediation to You, I am attentive to You and I seek your help.
And I seek bestowal and favor;
and I am a petitioner;
and I am humble
and sincere before You,

segments.arabic: وَ اَخْشَعُ لَكَ وَ اُقِرُّ لَكَ بِسُوْءِ صَنِيْعَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa akhsha-oâ laka wa oqirro laka be-soo-e sanee-aâtee,
segments.translation: and I confess to my evil deeds .
and I insist and persist before You

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِكُتُبِكَ الَّتِيْ اَنْزَلْتَهَا عَلٰى اَنْبِيَائِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa as-aloka bekotobekal latee anzaltahaa aâlaa anbeyaa-eka wa rosoleka,
segments.translation: I adjure by your Books that You revealed on the prophets and messengers
(your blessings and mercy be on them all).

segments.arabic: مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلِ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ،
segments.transliteration: menat tawraate wal injeele wal qur-aanil aâzeeme,
segments.translation: That is Taurat, Injeel and the great Quran
from its beginning till its end.
As it contains your great name and your beautiful names,

segments.arabic: وَ بِمَا فِيْهَا مِنْ اَسْمَائِكَ الْعُظْمٰى اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa bemaa feehaa min asmaa-ekal uâzmaa ataqarrabo elayka,
segments.translation: through which I seek your proximity.

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ،
segments.transliteration: wa as-aloka an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi,
segments.translation: I beseech You to bless Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad and remove their grief and sorrow and through their intercession,

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْ تُفَرِّجَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ تَجْعَلَ فَرَجِيْ مَقْرُوْنًا بِفَرَجِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tofarreja aân mohammadin wa aalehi wa taj-aâla farajee maqroonan be-farajehim,
segments.translation: remove my grief and sorrow as well,

segments.arabic: (وَ تُقَدِّمَهُمْ فِيْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ) وَ تَبْدَاَ بِهِمْ فِيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: (wa toqaddemahum fee kulle khayrin) wa tabda-a behim feehe,
segments.translation: and keep them at the forefront in every good,

segments.arabic: وَ تَفْتَحَ اَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ لِدُعَائِيْ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ،
segments.transliteration: wa taftaha abwaabas samaa-e le-do-aâa-ee fee haazal yawme,
segments.translation: and begin this only with them and today open the gates of heavens for my supplications

segments.arabic: وَ تَاْذَنَ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ بِفَرَجِيْ،
segments.transliteration: wa taazana fee haazal yawme wa haazehil laylate befarajee,
segments.translation: and today and tonight command peace for me

segments.arabic: وَ اِعْطَائِيْ سُؤْلِيْ وَ اَمَلِیْ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa e-aâtaa-ee soalee wa amalee fid dunyaa wal aakherate,
segments.translation: and fulfillment of all my demands as
poverty has besieged me
and difficulties surround me.

segments.arabic: وَ سَلَّمَتْنِي الْخَصَاصَةُ وَ اَلْجَاَتْنِيْ الْحَاجَةُ،
segments.transliteration: wa salla-matnil khasaasato wa al-ja-atnil haajato,
segments.translation: Needs have turned me over to You and needs have made me a refugee.
Humiliation has targeted
and poverty had overpowered,
and your word is proved true
and mistakes have surrounded me.

segments.arabic: وَ هٰذَا الْوَقْتُ الَّذِيْ وَعَدْتَ اَوْلِيَاءَكَ فِيْهِ الْاِجَابَةَ.
segments.transliteration: wa haazal waqtul lazee wa-aâdta awleyaa-aka feehil ejaabata.
segments.translation: This is the time,  when You promised acceptance to your friends.
bless Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ امْسَحْ مَا بِيْ بِيَمِيْنِكَ الشَّافِيَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wam sah maa bee be-yameenekash shaafeyate,
segments.translation: and remove my difficulties through your curative hands
and look upon me with mercy
and admit me in your wide mercy.

segments.arabic: وَ اَقْبِلْ اِلَيَّ بِوَجْهِكَ الَّذِيْ اِذَا اَقْبَلْتَ بِهٖ عَلٰى اَسِيْرٍ فَكَكْتَهٗ،
segments.transliteration: wa aqbil elayya be-wajhekal lazee ezaa aq-balta behi aâlaa aseerin fakaktahu,
segments.translation: Turn your towards me,  which if it is turned to the prisoner, he is freed.
And if it is turned to the misguided, he becomes guided.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلٰى جَائِزٍ اَدَّيْتَهٗ وَ عَلٰى فَقِیْرٍ اَغْنَيْتَهٗ،
segments.transliteration: wa aâlaa jaa-ezin addaytahu wa aâlaa faqeerin aghnaytahu,
segments.translation: And if it is turned to the perplexed, he is freed from perplexity. And if it is turned to the destitute, he becomes affluent.
If it is turned to the weak, he becomes strong.
If it is turned to the fearful, he is granted security.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُخْلِنِيْ لِقَاءَ عَدُوِّكَ وَ عَدُوِّيْ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tukhlenee leqaa-a aâduwweka wa aâduwwee,
segments.translation: O God, allow my and your enemy to meet me,
O owner of might and majesty.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَيْفَ هُوَ،
segments.transliteration: yaa man laa yaâlamo kayfa howa,
segments.translation: O One, whose reality, position

segments.arabic: وَ حَيْثُ هُوَ وَ قُدْرَتَهٗ اِلَّا هُوَ،
segments.transliteration: wa hayso howa wa qudratahu illaa howa,
segments.translation: and power is not known to anyone,except Him
O One, who has confined the atmosphere by the sky
and placed the earth on water
and chose the best names for Himself.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ سَمّٰى نَفْسَهٗ بِالْاِسْمِ الَّذِيْ بِهٖ تَقْضِيْ حَاجَةَ كُلِّ طَالِبٍ يَدْعُوْهُ بِهٖ.
segments.transliteration: yaa man sammaa nafsahu bil-ismil lazee behi taqzee haajata kulle taalebin yad-oâoho behi.
segments.translation: O that God, who adopted for Himself every that name through which He fulfills the needs of all those, who pray through them.
I beseech You through the mediation of your names
as I have no intercessor stronger than this.

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ (اَسْاَلُكَ) اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: wa be-haqqe mohammadin wa aale mohammadin (as-aloka) an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin,
segments.translation: And I adjure You by the right of Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad that You bless Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad
and fulfill all my pleas.

segments.arabic: وَ تُسْمِعَ مُحَمَّدًا وَ عَلِيًّا وَ فَاطِمَةَ،
segments.transliteration: wa tusme-aâ mohammadan wa aâliyyan wa faatemata,
segments.translation: And make my plea reach upto His Eminence Muhammad, Ali Fatima

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَسَنَ وَ الْحُسَيْنَ وَ عَلِيًّا وَ مُحَمَّدًا،
segments.transliteration: wal hasana wal husayna wa aâliyyan wa mohammadan,
segments.translation: Hassan Hussain Ali Muhammad
Jafar Musa

segments.arabic: وَ عَلِيًّا وَ مُحَمَّدًا وَ عَلِيًّا،
segments.transliteration: wa aâliyyan wa mohammadan wa aâliyyan,
segments.translation: Ali Muhammad Ali

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَسَنَ وَ الْحُجَّةَ - صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ بَرَكَاتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ – صَوْتِيْ،
segments.transliteration: wal hasana wal hujjata â salawaatoka aâlayhim wa barakaatoka wa rahmatoka â sawtee,
segments.translation: Hasan and Hujjat Qaim [your blessings and mercy be on them all],

segments.arabic: فَيَشْفَعُوْا لِيْ اِلَيْكَ وَ تُشَفِّعَهُمْ فِيَّ،
segments.transliteration: fayashfa-oâo lee elayka wa toshaf-fe-aâhum fiyya,
segments.translation: so that they may be able to recommend my case in your court and You allow them to intercede for me.
And donât turn me away in despair,
I adjure You by âthere is no god, except Allahâ and

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: wa be-haqqe mohammadin wa aale mohammadin,
segments.translation: I adjure You by Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin,
segments.translation: Bless Muhammad and his progeny

segments.arabic: وَ افْعَلْ بِيْ ’’كَذَا وَ كَذَا‘‘ يَا كَرِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: waf aâl bee âkazaa wa kazaaâ yaa kareemo.
segments.translation: conduct with me âas followsâ, O merciful God.

segments.arabic: بِحَقِّ يٰسۗ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْحَكِيْمِ، وَ بِحَقِّ طٰہٰ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: be-haqqe yaa-seen wal qur-aanil hakeeme, wa be-haqqe taahaa wal qur-aanil aâzeeme.
segments.translation: By the right of Yasin and the wise Quran and by the right of Taha and the great Quran.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَقْدِرُ عَلٰى حَوَائِجِ السَّائِلِيْنَ،
segments.transliteration: yaa man yaqdero aâlaa hawaa-ejis saa-eleena,
segments.translation: O One, who is capable of fulfilling the needs of all who ask.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِيْ الضَّمِيْرِ
segments.transliteration: yaa man yaâlamo maa fiz zameere
segments.translation: O One, who is aware of the secrets of the hearts.
O, One, who removes the distress from the distressed.
O One, who cures the grief of the aggrieved.
O One, who has mercy on the aged, helpless ones.
O sustainer of the small infant.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَاجُ اِلَى التَّفْسِيْرِ، صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَ افْعَلْ بِيْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا
segments.transliteration: yaa man laa yahtaajo elat tafseere,salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin, waf aâl bee kazaa wa kazaa.
segments.translation: O that God, who is not needful of any exegesis and explanation, bless Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad and conduct with me and do so and so.
O best seer of all those who can see,
O best hearer of all those who can hear,
O swiftest of those who settle account,
and O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
segments.transliteration: allahu rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'an
segments.translation: Allah is my Lord; I never associate any thing to Him.

segments.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
segments.translation: I put my trust in the Ever-living Who never dies.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bi-anna laka lhamda
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of (the fact) that to You is all praise;
there is no god save You, the All-donor,
the excellent originator of the heavens and the earth,
and the Lord of majesty and honor

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِي مِمَّا أَنَا فِيهِ فَرَجاً وَمَخْرَجاً
segments.transliteration: wa an taj`ala li mimma ana fihi farajan wa makhrajan
segments.translation: and to prepare for me a relief and way out from what I a

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ لاَ يَكْفِي مِنْكَ أَحَدٌ
segments.transliteration: allahumma innaka la yakfi minka ahadun
segments.translation: O Allah, nothing can ever save from You

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ تَكْفِي مِنْ كُلِّ أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa anta takfi min kulli ahadin min khalqika
segments.translation: while You alone can save from any of Your creatures;
so, save me fromâ¦
O He Who saves from all things
while nothing can ever save from You
neither in the heavens nor on the earth,

segments.arabic: ٱكْفِنِي مَا أَهَمَّنِي مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: ikfini ma ahammani min amri alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: (please) save me from what has distressed me, be it a this-worldly or a otherworldly affair,
and send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household.
With Allah do I commence,
from Allah do I seek success,

segments.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَتَوَجَّهُ
segments.transliteration: wa bimuhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi atawajjahu
segments.translation: and in the name of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, do I turn my face (towards Allah).
O Allah, (please) make easy for me the difficulty of this matter
and facilitate for me its complication,

segments.transliteration: fa'innaka tamhu ma tasha'u wa tuthbitu
segments.translation: for You verily efface what You will and establish (what You will)
and with You is the source of ordinance.
Sufficient to me is Allah.
There is no god but Him.
In Him do I trust
and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

segments.transliteration: wa amtani`u bihawli allahi wa quwwatihi
segments.translation: I take shelter in Allahâs might and power
against their might and power.
I take shelter in the Lord of the dawn
against the evil of what He has created.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
forgive me, have mercy upon me,
multiply my (good) deed, make easy my place of return,
guide my heart, secure my fear,
grant me wellbeing throughout my whole lifetime,
admit my plea, forgive my wrongdoings,

segments.transliteration: wa bayyid wajhi wa`simni fi dini
segments.translation: whiten my face, preserve me with regard to my faith,

segments.arabic: وَسَهِّلْ مَطْلَبِي وَوَسِّعْ عَلَيَّ فِي رِزْقِي
segments.transliteration: wa sahhil matlabi wa wassi` `alayya fi rizqi
segments.translation: make easy for me to attain my aim, and expand Your sustenance to me,
for I am too weak to do that.
(Please) overlook the evil I have done
in the name of the good You always do,
do not make me suffer from the loss of myself,
and do not make me suffer from the loss of one I intimately love.

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي يَا إِلٰهِي لَحْظَةً مِنْ لَحَظَاتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa hab li ya ilahi lahzatan min lahazatika
segments.translation: (Please) grant me, O my God, one of Your glances

segments.arabic: تَكْشِفُ بِهَا عَنِّي جَمِيعَ مَا بِهِ ابْتَلَيْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: takshifu biha `anni jami`a ma bihi ibtalaytani
segments.translation: through which You may relieve me from all what You have tested me through

segments.arabic: وَتَرُدُّ بِهَا عَلَيَّ مَا هُوَ أَحْسَنُ عَادَتِكَ عِنْدِي
segments.transliteration: wa taruddu biha `alayya ma huwa ahsanu `adatika `indi
segments.translation: and through which You may endue me again with the best of Your usual bestowals to me,

segments.transliteration: faqad da`ufat quwwati wa qallat hilati
segments.translation: for my power has decreased, my plans have failed,
and my hope in Your creatures have lost

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ رَجَاؤُكَ وَتَوَكُّلِي عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yabqa illa raja'uka wa tawakkuli `alayka
segments.translation: and nothing remained except my hope in You and my trust in You.

segments.arabic: وَقُدْرَتُكَ عَلَيَّ يَا رَبِّ أَنْ تَرْحَمَنِي وَتُعَافِيَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa qudratuka `alayya ya rabbi an tarhamani wa tu`afiyani
segments.translation: Your power, O my Lord, to have mercy upon me and to grant me wellbeing
is the same as Your power to chastise and afflict me.
O my God, my remembrance of Your conferrals entertains me
and my expectation of Your favors strengthens me.

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ أَخْلُ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa lam akhlu min ni`amika mundhu khalaqtani
segments.translation: I have never done without Your favors since You created me.
So, You are my lord, my master,
my shelter, my haven,
my protector, my defender,
the merciful to me, the guarantor of my sustenance,

segments.arabic: وَفِي قَضَائِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ كُلُّ مَا أَنَا فِيهِ
segments.transliteration: wa fi qada'ika wa qudratika kullu ma ana fihi
segments.translation: and whatever I am in is under Your decree and authority.
So, O my master and cherisher,

segments.transliteration: fima qadayta wa qaddarta wa hatamta
segments.translation: within Your decrees, decisions, and inevitable commands,

segments.arabic: تَعْجِيلُ خَلاَصِي مِمَّا أَنَا فِيهِ جَمِيعِهِ
segments.transliteration: ta`jilu khalasi mimma ana fihi jami`ihi
segments.translation: (please) decide on my salvation from all that which I am suffering
and on granting me wellbeing,

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي لاَ أَجِدُ لِدَفْعِ ذٰلِكَ أَحَداً غَيْرَكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'inni la ajidu lidaf`i dhalika ahadan ghayraka
segments.translation: for I cannot find any one who can do all that except You
and I trust in none save You.
O Lord of majesty and honor,

segments.arabic: عِنْدَ أَحْسَنِ ظَنِّي بِكَ وَرَجَائِي لَكَ
segments.transliteration: `inda ahsani zanni bika wa raja'i laka
segments.translation: (please) act according to the good idea I have about You and according to the hope I have in You,

segments.transliteration: warham tadarru`i wastikanati wa da`fa rukni
segments.translation: have mercy on my earnest humbleness, my submission, and the weakness of my support,

segments.arabic: وَٱمْنُنْ بِذٰلِكَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ دَاعٍ دَعَاكَ
segments.transliteration: wamnun bidhalika `alayya wa `ala kulli da`in da`aka
segments.translation: and endue me, as well as all suppliants that supplicate You, with all of that.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his Household.
In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),

segments.transliteration: wa min allahi wa ila allahi
segments.translation: from Allah (I derive power), to Allah (I resort),
in the way of Allah (I proceed),
and on the principles of Allahâs Messenger (I advance),
may Allah bless him and his Household.
O Allah, to You have I submitted myself,
towards You have I turned my face,
to You have I commended my cause,
and with You have I entrusted my affairs.
O Allah, (please) safeguard me with the safeguard of faith

segments.transliteration: min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi
segments.translation: before me, behind me,
to my right side, to my left side,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَمِنْ تَحْتِي وَمَا قِبَلِي
segments.transliteration: wa min fawqi wa min tahti wa ma qibali
segments.translation: above me, beneath me, and in front of me,
and defend me with Your might and power,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'innahu la hawla wa la quwwata illa bika
segments.translation: since there is neither might nor power except with You.
O He Who existed before all things!
O He Who composed all things!

segments.transliteration: wa ya baqiyan ba`da kulli shay'in
segments.translation: O He Who shall survive after all things!
(Please) bless Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household andâ¦

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَكْفِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man yakfi min kulli shay'in
segments.translation: O He Who saves from all things
but nothing can ever save from Him,
(please) save me from what has distressed me.
O target of all complaints!
O hearer of all confidential talks!
O witness of all gatherings!
O knower of all hidden things!

segments.arabic: وَيَا دَافِعَ مَا يَشَاءُ مِنْ بَلِيَّةٍ
segments.transliteration: wa ya dafi`a ma yasha'u min baliyyatin
segments.translation: O repelling of whatever tribulation You will to repel!
O friend of Abraham!
O talker to Moses!
O chooser of Muhammad,
may Allah bless him and his Household!
I supplicate You with the supplication of one whose indigence is extreme,
whose stratagem has failed,
and whose ability has fallen short;
the supplication of one who is stranger, drowned, distressed;

segments.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَجِدُ لِكَشْفِ مَا هُوَ فِيهِ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: alladhi la yajidu likashfi ma huwa fihi illa anta
segments.translation: one who has no one at all to relieve him from what he is suffering save You,
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
O Reliever of distress
and Remover of agony!

segments.transliteration: ya rahmana alddunya wal-akhirati wa rahimahuma
segments.translation: O Beneficent and Merciful of this world and the Hereafter,
(please) relieve my distress
and remove my agony.
O Allah Who is the One,
the One and Only, and the eternally besought of all;

segments.transliteration: alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad
segments.translation: Who begets not nor was begotten

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun
segments.translation: and there is none comparable unto Him,
(please) protect me, purify me,
and eliminate my tribulation.
O He Who is ever-living! O He Who is self-subsisting!
O He save Whom there is no god!
In the name of Your mercy do I seek aid;
so, (please) save me from what has distressed me
and do not refer me to myself.
O Allah, I beseech You
in the name of Muhammad and `Ali,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَهُمَا عِنْدَكَ شَأْناً مِنَ ٱلشَّأْنِ
segments.translation: for they both enjoy a remarkable standing with You
and a significant status;
so, (I beseech You) in the name of this standing
and in the name of this status

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa anâ¦
segments.translation: (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, andâ¦

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ عَلِيٍّ عِنْدَكَ ٱغْفِرْ لِعَلِيٍّ.
segments.translation: O Allah, (I beseech You) in the name of `Aliâs standing with You, (please) forgive `Ali.

title: Sunset Duas
text: Sunset Duas       Sunset Duas . Imam Sadiq(as) Sahifa Alawia - Kafi Resources Arabic Transliteration Translation It is highly advisable to engage yourself inÂ glorification of Almighty Allah and implorations for His forgiveness, because this hour is as importantÂ as the pre-sunrise hour, as Almighty Allah has said in the Holy Quran: ÙÙØ³ÙØ¨ÙÙØ­Ù Ø¨ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙØ¯Ù Ø±ÙØ¨ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ¨ÙÙÙ Ø·ÙÙÙÙØ¹Ù Ù±ÙØ´ÙÙÙ ÙØ³Ù ÙÙÙÙØ¨ÙÙÙ Ù±ÙÙØºÙØ±ÙÙØ¨Ù. And sing the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the setting. Imam al-Sadiq (`a) is reported to have said, âWhen the color of the sun changes (i.e. the sun is about to set), you must remember Allah the Almighty and Majestic. If you are at that hour with one who preoccupies you from this, you must leave him and supplicate.
