segments.arabic: وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ.
segments.translation: And sing the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the setting.
In this evening, my wrongdoing is taking shelter in Your pardon,
my sins are taking shelter in Your forgiveness,
my fear is taking shelter in Your security,
my humility is taking shelter in Your dignity,

segments.transliteration: wa amsa wajhiya albali mustajiran biwajhika aldda'imi albaqi
segments.translation: my poverty is taking shelter in Your richness,

segments.arabic: وَامْسَىٰ وَجْهِيَ ٱلْبَالِي مُسْتَجِيراً بِوَجْهِكَ ٱلدَّائِمِ ٱلْبَاقِي
segments.translation: and my mortal face is taking shelter in Your Face, the Undying and Perpetual.
O Allah, (please) dress me with Your wellbeing,
cover me with Your mercy,

segments.transliteration: wa qini sharra khalqika min aljinni wal-insi
segments.translation: overshadow me with Your honoring,

segments.arabic: وَقِنِي شَرَّ خَلْقِكَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنْسِ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya rahmanu ya rahimu
segments.translation: and protect me against the evils of Your creaturesâjinn and men.

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيمُ
segments.translation: O Allah! O All-beneficent! O All-merciful!
O He Who has sealed the Prophethood with Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: ikhtim li fi yawmi hadha bikhayrin
segments.translation: Allah may bless him and his Household,

segments.arabic: إِخْتِمْ لِي فِي يَوْمِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
segments.translation: (please) seal with goodness this day of mine,
this month of mine,
this year of mine,
and my entire lifetime.
I include myself, my family,
my property, and my sons,

segments.transliteration: billahi alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: both the absent and the present

segments.arabic: بِٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ هُوَ
segments.translation: with Allah save Whom there is no god,
the Knower of the unseen and the seen,
the All-beneficent, the All-merciful,

segments.transliteration: la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawmun
segments.translation: the Ever-living, the Self-subsisting.

segments.transliteration: lahu ma fi alssamawati wa ma fi al-ardi
segments.translation: Slumber does not overtake Him nor sleep.

segments.arabic: لَهُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلارْضِ
segments.transliteration: man dha alladhi yashfa`u `indahu illa bi'idhnihi
segments.translation: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth is His.

segments.arabic: مَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya`lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum
segments.translation: Who is he that can intercede with Him but by His permission?

segments.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ ايْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa la yuhituna bishay'in min `ilmihi illa bima sha'a
segments.translation: He knows what is before them and what is behind them,

segments.arabic: وَلا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ
segments.translation: and they cannot comprehend anything out of His knowledge except what He pleases.
His knowledge extends over the heavens and the earth,
and the preservation of them both tires Him not,
and He is the Most High, the Great.

segments.transliteration: al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu sharÄ«kun
segments.translation: In the name of Allah the Beneficent the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَیْکَ بِجُوْدِکَ وَ کَرَمِکَ وَ اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَیْکَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِکَ وَ رَسُوْلِکَ وَ اَتَقَرُّبُ اِلَیْکَ بِمَلَآئِکَتِکَ الْمُقَرَّبِیْنَ وَ اَنْبِیَآئِکَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ وَ بِکَ
segments.transliteration: fÄ« al-mulki al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« yaá¹£ifu wa lÄ yÅ«á¹£afu
segments.translation: I wish to seek proximity to You by Your grace and generosity and by Your special servant Mohammed peace be on him and his progeny and through You and through the angels who are near to You.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ لَکَ الْغِنٰی وَ بِیَ الْفَاقَۃُ اِلَیْکَ اَنْتَ الْغَنِیُّ وَ اَنَا الْفَقِیْرُ اِلَیْکَ اَقِلْنِیْ عَثْرَتِیْ وَاسْتُرْ عَلَیَّ ذُنُوْبِیْ وَاقْضِ الْیَوْمَ حَاجَتِیْ وَلاَ تُعَذِّبْنِیْ بِقَبِیْحِ مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنِّیْ بَلْ عَفْوُکَ یَسْعُنِیْ وَ جُوْدُکَ
segments.transliteration: wa yaÊ¿lamu wa lÄ yuÊ¿lamu yaÊ¿lamu khÄÊ¾inata al-Ê¾aÊ¿yuni wa mÄ tukhfÄ« al-á¹£udÅ«ru
segments.translation: O Allah Self Sufficiency belongs to You and for me is the dependency in Your Presence You are rich and I am indigent forgive my laxities, conceal my sins, and today fulfill my desires, and whatever sins You are aware of, don't chastise me, but put me in Your mercy and Generosity

segments.arabic: یَا اَہْلَ التَّقْوٰی وَ یَا اَہْلَ الْمَغْفِرَۃِ یَا بَرُّ یَا رَحِیْمُ اَنْتَ اَبَرُّ بِیْ مِنْ اَبِیْ وَ اُمِّیْ وَ مِنْ جَمِیْعٍ الْخَلَآئِقِ اَقْبِسْنِیْ بِقَضَآءِ حَاجَتِیْ مُجَاباً دُعَآئِیْ مَرْحُوْمًا صَوْتِیْ قَدْ کَشَفْتَ اَنْوَاعَ الْبَلاَ یَا عَنِیْ
segments.transliteration: Ê¾aÊ¿Å«dhu bi-wajhi AllÄhi al-karÄ«mi wa bi-smi AllÄhi al-Ê¿aáºÄ«mi
segments.translation: O the center of piety, O the possessor of forgiveness, O the most generous for the doers of good. You are more generous than my father, my mother and the entire universe. Pass my life in fulfilling my desires. Accept my prayers, have mercy on my voice, You have averted various types of difficulties from me.

segments.transliteration: min sharri mÄ dharaÊ¾a wa mÄ baraÊ¾a wa min sharri mÄ taá¸¥ta al-tharÃ¡
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri mÄ áºahara wa mÄ baá¹­ana wa min sharri mÄ kÄna
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah, who has not taken a son and has no partner

segments.arabic: فِي الْمُلْكِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يَصِفُ وَلَا يُوصَفُ
segments.transliteration: fÄ« al-layli wa al-nahÄri wa min sharri abÄ« murrata wa mÄ walada
segments.translation: In the kingdom. Praise be to Allah, who describes and is not described,

segments.arabic: وَيَعْلَمُ وَلَا يُعْلَمُ يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri al-rasÄ«si wa min sharri mÄ waá¹£aftu wa mÄ lam aá¹£if
segments.translation: And knows and is not known. He knows the treachery of the eyes and what the hearts conceal.

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the noble countenance of Allah and in the name of Allah, the Great,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ وَمَا بَرَأَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَحْتَ الثَّرَى
segments.translation: From the evil of what He created and originated, and from the evil of what is beneath the soil,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ظَهَرَ وَمَا بَطَنَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا كَانَ
segments.translation: And from the evil of what is visible and what is hidden, and from the evil of what is

segments.arabic: فِي اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ أَبِي مُرَّةَ وَمَا وَلَدَ
segments.translation: In the night and the day, and from the evil of Abi Murrah and what he begets,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ الرَّسِيسِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا وَصَفْتُ وَمَا لَمْ أَصِفْ
segments.translation: And from the evil of ar-Rasees, and from the evil of what I have described and what I have not described.
So praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

title: Ziyarat Nahiya Duas.org
text: Ziyarat Nahiya Duas.org       Ziyarah Nahiya Salutation on Imam Hussain(as) by Imam Mahdi(ajtfs) Signifance of this ziyarah Signifance of this ziyarah × Introduction and Translation by: Vahid Majd Naba Organization ISBN: 964-8323-13-5, First Edition: 2004Email: [email protected] âBut as I have been hindered by the course of time, and (Allahâs) decree has prevented me from helping you, and as I could not fight those who fought you, and was not able to show hostility to those who showed hostility to you, I will, therefore, lament you morning and evening, and will weep blood in place of tears, out of my anguish for you and my sorrow for all that befell youâ¦â âImam al-Mahdi (PBUH) Of the several prescribed Ziyarat of Imam al-Husain (PBUH), one was recited by Imam al-Mahdi (PBUH) and reached us through one of his four special deputies. For that reason, it is known as the Ziyarat that was issued from the sacred side (Ziyarat al-Nahiya al-Muqaddasa).[1] One of the most important features of this Ziyarat is that in different phrases, Imam al-Mahdi (PBUH) graphically describes the events of Ashura and the agony that Imam al-Husain (PBUH) and his family faced on that horrific and ominous day. The text of the Ziyarat al-Nahiya is found in some early Ziyarat collections such as al-Mazar al-Kabir, by Muhammad Ibn Jaâfar al-Mashâhadi, pp. 496-513. It is also reported in al-Mazar, by al-Mufid as mentioned in Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 98, pp. 318-329. An overview of the Ziyarat al-Nahiya Since this Ziyarat (as reported in al-Mazar al-Kabir, by al-Mashâhadi) originated from an infallible Imam who is the tongue of Allah, it is replete with divine recognition, guidance, spirituality, knowledge of religion, lessons for humanity, and the historical facts. The method of presentation in this Ziyarat follows the formal method seen in other texts by Ahl al-Bait (PBUT). The text of this Ziyarat can be divided into the following ten major parts: 1- Of

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى آدَمَ صِفْوَةِ اللهِ مِنْ خَليقَتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Adam, the chosen one of Allah from among His creation.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى شَيْثٍ وَلِيِّ اللهِ وَ خِيَرَتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Seth (Shaith), the friend of Allah and His elite.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى إدْريسَ الْقائِمِ للهِِ بِحُجَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon Enoch (Idris), who established (religion) on behalf of Allah by His authority.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى نُوحٍ الْمُجابِ في دَعْوَتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Noah (Nuh), whose invocation (for punishment) was answered.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى هُودٍ الْمَمْدُودِ مِنَ اللهِ بِمَعُونَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄÂ hÅ«dinilÂ mamdÅ«diÂ minal-lÄhiÂ bi-maÅ«natih,
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Hud, who was assisted through Allahâs aid.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى صالِحِ الَّذي تَوَّجَهُ اللهُ بِكَرامَتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Salih, whom Allah crowned with His generosity.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى إبْراهيمَ الَّذي حَباهُ اللهُ بِخُلَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Abraham (Ibrahim), whom Allah endowed with His friendship.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى إسْماعيلَ الَّذي فَداهُ اللهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظيمٍ مِنْ جَنَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄ 'ismaÄ«lal-ladhÄ«Â fadÄhul-lÄhuÂ bi-dhibÄ§inÂ aÄÄ«min minÂ jannatih
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Ishmael (Ismaâil), whom Allah ransomed with a great sacrifice from His Heaven.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى إسْحاقَ الَّذي جَعَلَ اللهُ النُّبُوَّةَ في ذُرِّيَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Isaac (Isâhaq), in whose progeny Allah placed prophethood.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى يَعْقُوبَ الَّذي رَدَّ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ بَصَرَهُ بِرَحْمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄ yaqÅ«bal-ladhÄ«Â raddal-lÄhuÂ alayhiÂ baÅ¡arahuÂ bi-raÄ§matih,
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Jacob (Yaâqub), for whom Allah restored his sight by His mercy.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى يُوسُفَ الَّذي نَجّاهُ اللهُ مِنَ الْجُبِّ بِعَظَمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄÂ yÅ«sufal-ladhÄ«Â najjÄhul-lÄhuÂ minalÂ jubbiÂ bi-aÄamatih,
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Joseph (Yusuf), whom Allah rescued from the well by His majesty.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مُوسَى الَّذي فَلَقَ اللهُ الْبَحْرَ لَهُ بِقُدْرَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄÂ mÅ«sal-ladhÄ«Â falaqal-lÄhulÂ baÄ§raÂ lahuÂ bi-qudratih,
segments.translation: Peace be upon Moses (Musa), the one for whom Allah split the sea with His Power.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى هارُونَ الَّذي خَصَّهُ اللهُ بِنُبُوَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Aaron (Harun), whom Allah distinguished with his prophethood.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى شُعَيْبِ الَّذي نَصَرَهُ اللهُ عَلى اُمَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Jethro (Shuâaib), whom Allah made victorious over his people.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى داوُدَ الَّذي تابَ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَطيئَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄÂ dÄwÅ«dal-ladhÄ«Â tÄbal-lÄhuÂ alayhi minÂ khaÅ£Ä«'atih,
segments.translation: Peace be upon David (Dawud), to whom Allah turned (in mercy) after his mistake.[1]

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى سُلَيْمانَ الَّذي ذَلَّتْ لَهُ الْجِنُّ بِعِزَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄÂ sulaymÄnal-ladhÄ«dhallatÂ lahulÂ jinnuÂ bi-izzatih,
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Solomon (Sulaiman), for whom Allah made the Jinn subservient by His majesty.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى أيُّوبَ الَّذي شَفاهُ اللهُ مِنْ عِلَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Job (Ayyub), whom Allah cured after his (prolonged) illness.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى يُونُسَ الَّذي أنْجَزَ اللهُ لَهُ مَضْمُونَ عِدَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄÂ yÅ«nusal-ladhÄ«Â 'anjazal-lÄhuÂ lahuÂ maÄhmÅ«naÂ idatih,
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Jonah (Yunus), for whom Allah fulfilled the purport of His promise.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى عُزَيْرِ الَّذي أحْياهُ اللهُ بَعْدَ ميتَتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Ezra (Uzair), whom Allah brought to life after his death.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى زَكَرِيّا الصّابِرِ في مِحْنَتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Zechariah (Zakariyya), who remained patient in his tribulations.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى يَحْيَى الَّذي أزْلَفَهُ اللهُ بِشَهادَتِهِ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon John (Yahya), whom Allah drew near (his rank) by his martyrdom.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى عيسى رُوحِ اللهِ وَ كَلِمَتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Jesus (Isa), the spirit of Allah and His word.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ حَبيبِ اللهِ وَ صِفْوَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄÂ muÄ§ammaddinÂ Ä§abÄ«bil-lÄhiÂ waÂ Å¡ifwatih,
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon Muhammad, the beloved of Allah and His elite.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى أميرِالْمُؤْمِنينَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أبي طالِبٍ الْمَخْصُوصِ بِاُخُوَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄ 'amÄ«rilÂ mu'minÄ«naÂ aliyy-ibni 'abÄ«Â Å£Älibinil-makhÅ¡Å«Å¡iÂ bi-'ukhuwwatih,
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon the Leader of the Faithful, Ali Ibn Abi Talib, who was exclusively selected for brotherhood to him (the ProphetÂ (PBUH&HF)).
PeaceÂ beÂ uponÂ FatimaÂ al-Zahra, his daughter.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى أبي مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَسَنِ وَصِيِّ أبيهِ وَ خَليفَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmuÂ alÄ 'abiÂ muÄ§ammadinil-Ä§asaniÂ waÅ¡iyyiÂ 'abÄ«hiÂ waÂ khalÄ«fatih,
segments.translation: Peace be upon Abu Muhammad al-Hasan, the executor of (the will of) his father, and his successor.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الْحُسَيْنِ الَّذي سَمَحَتْ نَفْسُهُ بِمُهْجَتِهِ،
segments.translation: PeaceÂ beÂ upon al-Husain, who sacrificed himself up to the last drops of the blood of his heart.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنْ أطاعَ اللهَ في سِرِّهِ وَ عَلانِيَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmu alÄ man 'aÅ£Äal-lÄha fÄ« sirrihi wa alÄniyatih,
segments.translation: Peace be upon him, who obeyed Allah secretly and openly.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنْ جَعَلَ اللهُ الشِّفاءَ في تُرْبَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmu alÄ man jaalal-lÄhush-shifÄ'a fÄ« turbatih,
segments.translation: Peace be upon whom Allah placed a cure in the soil of his place (of martyrdom).

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنِ الإجابَةُ تَحْتَ قُبَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon the one under whose dome answer (to supplications) is guaranteed.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنِ الأئِمَّةُ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon the one in whose descendants are the Imams (after him).
Peace be upon the son of the seal of the prophets.
Peace be upon the son of the chief of the executors.
Peace be upon the son ofÂ Fatima, the radiant.
Peace be upon the son of Khadija, the great.
Peace be upon the son of the lote-tree in the outermost boundary (of Heaven).[1]
Peace be upon the son of the Garden of refuge.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى ابْنِ زَمْزَمَ وَ الصَّفا،
segments.translation: Peace be upon the son of Zamzam and al-Safaa.
Peace be upon him, who was saturated in (his) blood.
Peace be upon him, whose tents were violated.
Peace be upon the fifth of the People of the Cloak.
Peace be upon the loneliest of the lonely.
Peace be upon the (greatest) martyr of all martyrs.
Peace be upon him, who was slain by the individuals of illegitimate birth.
Peace be upon the one who is at rest inÂ Karbala.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنْ بَكَتْهُ مَلائِكَةُ السَّماءِ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon the one for whom the heavenly Angels wept.
Peace be upon the one whose descendants are the pure.
Peace be upon the chief of the religion.
Peace be upon the places of the (divine) proofs.
Peace be upon the Imams, the masters (of mankind).
Peace be upon the bloodstained chests.
Peace be upon the parched lips.
Peace be upon the plucked souls.
Peace be upon the snatched spirits.
Peace be upon the stripped corpses.
Peace be upon the pallid bodies.
Peace be upon the gushing bloods.
Peace be upon the dismembered limbs.
Peace be upon the heads raised upon lances.
Peace be upon the women (forcibly) exposed.
Peace be upon the Proof of the Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلى آبائِكَ الطّاهِرينَ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon your pure ancestors.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلى أبْنائِكَ الْمُسْتَشْهَدينَ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon your martyred sons.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلى ذُرِّيَّتِكَ النّاصِرينَ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon your children who aided (you).

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلَى الْمَلائِكَةِ الْمُضاجِعينَ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmu alayka wa alal malÄ'ikatil muÄhÄjiÄ«n,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon the accompanying Angels.
Peace be upon the slain and the oppressed one.
Peace be upon his poisoned brother (Imam al-Hasan).
Peace be upon Ali, the elder (Ali al-Akbar).
Peace be upon the suckling infant (Ali al-Asghar).
Peace be upon the plundered bodies.
Peace be upon the family and children who were nearby (the place of martyrdom) [who were without support among strangers].
Peace be upon the mangled corpses (left) in the desert.
Peace be upon those who were left far from their homeland.
Peace be upon those who were buried without shrouds.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الرُّؤُوسِ الْمُفَرَّقَةِ عَنِ الأبْدانِ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon the heads severed from the bodies.
Peace be upon the bereaved and the patient one.
Peace be upon the oppressed one who was without a helper.
Peace be upon the inhabitant of the purified soil.
Peace be upon the possessor of the lofty dome.
Peace be upon him, whom the Almighty purified.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنِ افْتَخَرَ بِهِ جَبْرَئيلُ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon him, of whom Gabriel (Jabraâil) was proud.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنْ ناغاهُ فِي الْمَهْدِ ميكائيلُ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmu alÄ man nÄghÄhu fil mahdi mÄ«kÄ'Ä«l,
segments.translation: Peace be upon the one to whom Michael (Mikaâil) spoke tenderly in the cradle.
Peace be upon the one whose pact was broken.
Peace be upon the one whose rights and dignity were violated.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنْ اُريقَ بِالظُّلْمِ دَمُهُ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon the one whose blood was shed unjustly.
Peace be upon the one who was bathed in the blood of his wounds.
Peace be upon the one who tasted the spears raining down over his body.
Peace be upon the one against whom people came together and made lawful the shedding of his blood.
Peace be upon the one slaughtered in public.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنْ دَفَنَهُ أهْلُ الْقُرى،
segments.translation: Peace be upon the one who was buried by the strangers from (nearby) villages.
Peace be upon the one whoseÂ aorta was severed.
Peace be upon the defender who had no helper.
Peace be upon the gray hair that was dyed (with blood).
Peace be upon the cheek that struck the dust.
Peace be upon the butchered body.
Peace be upon the front teeth that were beaten with a rod.
Peace be upon the head raised (upon a lance).

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الأجْسامِ الْعارِيَةِ فِي الْفَلَواتِ، تَنْهَشُهَا الذِّئابُ الْعادِياتُ، وَ تَخْتَلِفُ إلَيْهَا السِّباعُ الضّارِياتُ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmu alal 'ajsÄmil Äriyati fil falawÄt, tanhashuhadh-dhi'Äbul ÄdiyÄt, wa takhtalifu 'ilayhas-sibÄuÄh-ÄhÄriyÄt,
segments.translation: Peace be upon the unclothed corpses in the desert, bitten by wild wolves[1]Â and around whom the beasts of prey prowled.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يا مَوْلايَ وَ عَلَى الْمَلائِكَةِ الْمُرَفْرَفينَ حَوْلَ قُبَّتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmu alayka yÄ mawlÄy wa alal malÄ'ikatil murafrafÄ«na Ä§awla qubbatik,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O my master, and the Angels
who flutter around your dome,

segments.arabic: الْحافّينَ بِتُرْبَتِكَ، الطّائِفينَ بِعَرْصَتِكَ، الْوارِدينَ لِزِيارَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-Ä§ÄffÄ«na biturrbatik, aÅ£-Å£Ä'ifÄ«na biarÅ¡atik, al-wÄridÄ«na liziyÄratik,
segments.translation: surround your grave, circumambulate your courtyard, and come for your visitation.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ فَإنّي قَصَدْتُ إلَيْكَ، وَ رَجَوْتُ الْفَوْزَ لَدَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: assalÄmu alayka fa'innÄ« qaÅ¡adtu 'ilayk, wa rajawtul fawza ladayk,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you! Indeed, I intended your visitation, and I am hopeful of achieving the prosperity that is with you.
Salutations to you,

segments.arabic: سَلامَ الْعارِفِ بِحُرْمَتِكَ، الْمُخْلِصِ في وِلايَتِكَ، الْمُتَقَرِّبِ إلَى اللهِ بِمَحَبَّتِكَ، الْبَريءِ مِنْ أعْدائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: salÄmal Ärifi biÄ§urmatik, al-mukhliÅ¡i fÄ« wilÄyatik, al-mutaqqarribi 'ilal-lÄhi bimaÄ§abbatik, al-barÄ«'i min 'adÄ'ik,
segments.translation: Salutations from he who recognizes your sanctity, is a sincere (believer) in your guardianship, seeks nearness to Allah through your love, and is aloof from your enemies,

segments.arabic: سَلامَ مَنْ قَلْبُهُ بِمُصابِكَ مَقْرُوحٌ، وَ دَمْعُهُ عِنْدَ ذِكْرِكَ مَسْفُوحٌ،
segments.transliteration: salÄma man qalbuhu bimuÅ¡Äbika maqrÅ«Ä§, wa damuhu inda dhikrika masfÅ«Ä§,
segments.translation: Salutations from the one whose heart is wounded due to the tribulations you have suffered, and whose tears flow in your remembrance,
Salutations from the one who is distressed, grief-stricken, distracted, and yielding,

segments.arabic: سَلامَ مَنْ لَوْ كانَ مَعَكَ بِالطُّفُوفِ، لَوَقاكَ بِنَفْسِهِ حَدَّ السُّيُوفِ، وَ بَذَلَ حُشاشَتَهُ دُونَكَ لِلْحُتُوفِ،
segments.transliteration: salÄma man law kÄna maaka biÅ£-Å£ufÅ«f, lawaqÄka binafsihi Ä§addas-suyÅ«f, wa badhala Ä§ushÄshatahu dÅ«naka lil Ä§utÅ«f,
segments.translation: Salutations from the one, who, had he been present with you in that plain, would have shielded you from the sharpness of the swords with his body and sacrificed his last breath for you,

segments.arabic: وَ جاهَدَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، وَ نَصَرَكَ عَلى مَنْ بَغى عَلَيْكَ، وَ فَداكَ بِرُوحِهِ وَ جَسَدِهِ وَ مالِهِ وَ وَلَدِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa jÄhada bayna yadayk, wa naÅ¡araka alÄ man baghÄ alayk, wa fadÄka birÅ«Ä§ihi wa jasadihi wa mÄlihi wa waladih,
segments.translation: would have struggled beside you, helped you against the aggressors, and redeemed you with his soul, body, wealth, and children,
(Salutations from the one) whose soul is a sacrifice for yours,
and whose family is a shield for yours.

segments.arabic: فَلَئِنْ أخَّرَتْنِي الدُّهُورُ، وَ عاقَني عَنْ نَصْرِكَ الْمَقْدُورُ،
segments.transliteration: fala'in 'akh-kharatnid-duhÅ«r, wa ÄqanÄ« an naÅ¡rikal maqdÅ«r
segments.translation: But as I have been hindered by the course of time and as (Allahâs) decree has prevented me from helping you,

segments.arabic: وَ لَمْ أكُنْ لِمَنْ حارَبَكَ مُحارِباً، وَ لِمَنْ نَصَبَ لَكَ الْعَداوَةَ مُناصِباً،
segments.transliteration: wa lam 'akun liman Ä§Ärabaka muÄ§ÄribÄ, wa liman naÅ¡aba lakal adÄwata munÄÅ¡ibÄ,
segments.translation: and as I could not fight those who fought you, and was not able to show hostility to those who showed hostility to you,

segments.arabic: فَلَأَنْدُبَنَّكَ صَباحاً وَ مَساءً وَ لَأَبْكِيَنَّ لَكَ بَدَلَ الدُّمُوعِ دَماً، حَسْرَةً عَلَيْكَ وَ تَأسُّفاً عَلى ما دَهاكَ وَ تَلَهُّفاً،
segments.transliteration: Fala'andubannaka Å¡abÄÄ§an wa masÄ'Ä, wa la'abkiyanna laka badalad-dumÅ«i damÄ, Ä§asratan alayka wa ta'assufan alÄ mÄ dahÄka wa talahhufÄ,
segments.translation: I will, therefore, lament you morning and evening, and will weep blood in place of tears, out of my anguish for you and my sorrow for all that befell you,

segments.arabic: حَتّى أمُوتَ بِلَوْعَةِ الْمُصابِ، وَ غُصَّةِ الإكْتِيابِ،
segments.translation: until I meet death from the pain of the catastrophe and the choking grief.

segments.arabic: أشْهَدُ أ نَّكَ قَدْ أقَمْتَ الصَّلوةَ، وَ آتَيْتَ الزَّكوةَ،
segments.translation: I bear witness that you certainly established prayer, gave alms,

segments.arabic: وَ أمَرْتَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، وَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَ الْعُدْوانِ،
segments.transliteration: wa 'amarta bil marÅ«f, wa nahayta anil munkari wal udwÄn,
segments.translation: enjoined good, forbade evil and transgression,

segments.arabic: وَ أطَعْتَ اللهَ وَ ما عَصَيْتَهُ، وَ تَمَسَّكْتَ بِهِ وَ بِحَبْلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa 'aÅ£atal-lÄha wa mÄ aÅ¡aytah, wa tamassakta bihi wa bi Ä§ablih,
segments.translation: obeyed Allah, never disobeyed Him, and held fast to Him and to His rope.

segments.arabic: فَأرْضَيْتَهُ وَ خَشيتَهُ وَ راقَبْتَهُ وَ اسْتَجَبْتَهُ،
segments.transliteration: fa 'arÄhaytahu wa khashaytahu wa rÄqabtahu wastajabtah,
segments.translation: Then, you pleased Him, held Him in awe, were attentive towards Him, and were responsive to Him,

segments.arabic: وَ سَنَنْتَ السُّنَنَ، وَ أطْفَأْتَ الْفِتَنَ،
segments.translation: established the customs (of the ProphetÂ (PBUH&HF)), extinguished turmoil (in religion),

segments.arabic: وَ دَعَوْتَ إلَى الرَّشادِ، وَ أوْضَحْتَ سُبُلَ السَّدادِ، وَ جاهَدْتَ فِي اللهِ حَقَّ الْجِهادِ،
segments.transliteration: wa daawta 'ilar-rashÄd, wa 'awÄhaÄ§ta subulas-sadÄd, wa jÄhadta fil-lÄhi Ä§aqqal jihÄd,
segments.translation: invited people to rectitude, clarified the ways of righteousness, and truly strove in the way of Allah.
You were an obedient one to Allah,

segments.arabic: وَ لِجَدِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ تابِعاً،
segments.transliteration: wali jaddika muÄ§ammadin Å¡allal-lÄhu alayhi wa Älihi tÄbiÄ,
segments.translation: a follower of your grandfather, Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family,
heedful of the saying of your father,
quick to execute the will of your brother,

segments.arabic: وَ لِعِمادِ الدّينِ رافِعاً، وَ لِلطُّغْيانِ قامِعاً،
segments.transliteration: wali imÄdid-dÄ«ni rÄfiÄ, wa liÅ£-Å£ughyÄni qÄmiÄ,
segments.translation: an erector of the pillars of the religion, a suppressor of tyranny,

segments.arabic: وَ لِلطُّغاةِ مُقارِعاً، وَ لِلأُمَّةِ ناصِحاً،
segments.transliteration: wa liÅ£-Å£ughÄti muqÄriÄ, wa lil 'ummati nÄÅ¡iÄ§Ä,
segments.translation: an advancer on the transgressors, and a sincere exhorter for the nation,
a traveler into mortal throes,

segments.arabic: وَ لِلْفُسّاقِ مُكافِحاً، وَ بِحُجَجِ اللهِ قائِماً،
segments.transliteration: wa lil fussÄqi mukÄfiÄ§Ä, wa bi-Ä§ujajil-lÄhi qÄ'imÄ,
segments.translation: a warrior against the wretched, and a maintainer of Allahâs proofs (on earth),
compassionate towards Islam and Muslims,

segments.arabic: وَ لِلْحَقِّ ناصِراً، وَ عِنْدَ الْبَلاءِ صابِراً،
segments.transliteration: wa lil Ä§aqqi nÄÅ¡irÄ, wa indal balÄ'i Å¡ÄbirÄ,
segments.translation: a champion of truth and most patient in adversity,

segments.arabic: وَ لِلدّينِ كالِئاً، وَ عَنْ حَوْزَتِهِ مُرامِياً،
segments.transliteration: wa liddÄ«ni kÄli'Ä, wa an Ä§awzatihi murÄmiyÄ,
segments.translation: a protector for the religion, and a defender of its domain.
You safeguarded the right path and supported it,
spread justice and promoted it,
advocated the faith and manifested it,
restrained and reproached the frivolous,
took back (the rights) of the lowly from the privileged,

segments.arabic: وَ تُساوي فِي الْحُكْمِ بَيْنَ الْقَوِيِّ وَ الضَّعيفِ،
segments.transliteration: wa tusÄwÄ« fil Ä§ukmi baynal qawiyyi waÄh-ÄhaÄ«f,
segments.translation: and were equitable in your arbitrations between the weak and the strong.

segments.arabic: كُنْتَ رَبيعَ الأيْتامِ، وَ عِصْمَةَ الأنامِ، وَ عِزَّ الإسْلامِ،
segments.transliteration: kunta rabÄ«al 'aytÄm, wa iÅ¡matal 'anÄm, wa izzal 'islÄm,
segments.translation: You were the springtime of the orphans, the protection of humanity, the glory of Islam,

segments.arabic: وَ مَعْدِنَ الأحْكامِ، وَ حَليفَ الإنْعامِ،
segments.translation: the treasure of divine laws, and a relentless ally of benevolence.

segments.arabic: سالِكاً طَرائِقَ [في طَريقَةِ] جَدِّكَ وَ أبيكَ،
segments.translation: You pursued the path of your grandfather and your father,
resembled your brother in will,
were loyal to your obligations, possessed pleasant manners,
embodied generosity, and spent the darkness (of night) in prayer.

segments.arabic: قَويمَ الطَّرائِقِ، كَريمَ الْخَلائِقِ، عَظيمَ السَّوابِقِ،
segments.translation: You were the straightest path, the most generous of the creation, and had the brightest record.

segments.arabic: شَريفَ النَّسَبِ، مُنيفَ الْحَسَبِ، رَفيعَ الرُّتَبِ،
segments.translation: You were of great ancestry, noble descent, and lofty rank.

segments.arabic: كَثيرَ الْمَناقِبِ، مَحْمُودَ الضَّرائِبِ، جَزيلَ الْمَواهِبِ،
segments.translation: You possessed plentiful merits, praiseworthy manners, and were abundant in endowments.

segments.arabic: حَليمٌ رَشيدٌ مُنيبٌ، جَوادٌ عَليمٌ شَديدٌ،
segments.transliteration: Ä§alÄ«mun rashÄ«dun munÄ«b, jawÄdun alÄ«mun shadÄ«d,
segments.translation: You were forbearing, upright, always turning (to Allah), generous, knowledgeable, strong,

segments.arabic: إمامٌ شَهيدٌ، أوّاهٌ مُنيبٌ، حَبيبٌ مَهيبٌ،
segments.translation: a martyred Imam, grieved, repentant with earnest prayers (to Allah), dearly loved, and awesome.

segments.arabic: كُنْتَ لِلرَّسُولِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَلَداً،
segments.transliteration: kunta lir-rasÅ«li Å¡allal-lÄhu alayhi wa Älihi waladÄ,
segments.translation: You were to the Messenger, peace be upon him and his family, a son,
for the Quran, an authority [a savior],
and for the nation, a support.
You were diligent in obedience,
a protector of the covenant and oath,
keeping away from the paths of the debauched,
sparing no effort (in fulfilling the duties),
performing prolonged bowing and prostrations,

segments.arabic: زاهِداً فِي الدُّنْيا زُهْدَ الرّاحِلِ عَنْها،
segments.translation: abstaining from the world, like one who is departing from it,
looking upon it (the world) through the eyes of one estranged (from it).
Your desires from it (the world) were abstentious,
your efforts were far-removed from its embellishments,
your glances removed from its joys,
and your desire for the hereafter was well-known,
even when tyranny became wide-spread,
injustice removed its veil,
wickedness called upon its followers,

segments.arabic: وَ أنْتَ في حَرَمِ جَدِّكَ قاطِنٌ،
segments.translation: and you were residing in the sanctuary of your grandfather,
detached from the oppressors,
sitting in the house and the prayer niche,
unattached to (worldly) pleasures and carnal desires,

segments.arabic: تُنْكِرُ الْمُنْكَرَ بِقَلْبِكَ وَ لِسانِكَ، عَلى حَسَبِ طاقَتِكَ وَ إمْكانِكَ،
segments.transliteration: tunkirul munkara biqalbika wa lisÄnik, alÄ Ä§asabi Å£Äqatika wa 'imkÄnik,
segments.translation: and renouncing evil in your heart and on your tongue to the extent of your strength and ability.
Then the knowledge demanded you for disavowal (of falsehood),
and made it incumbent on you to struggle against the deviant.

segments.arabic: فَسِرْتَ في أوْلادِكَ وَ أهاليكَ، وَ شيعَتِكَ وَ مَواليكَ
segments.transliteration: fasirta fÄ« 'awlÄdika wa 'ahÄlÄ«k, wa shÄ«atika wa mawÄlÄ«k,
segments.translation: Therefore, you set out in company of your children, kinsfolk, followers, and supporters,

segments.transliteration: wa Å¡adata bil Ä§aqqi wal bayyinah,
segments.translation: disclosed the truth and clear proofs,

segments.arabic: وَ دَعَوْتَ إلَى اللهِ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَ الْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa daawta 'ilal-lÄhi bil Ä§ikmakti wal mawiÄatil Ä§asanah,
segments.translation: summoned people towards Allah with wisdom and fine exhortation,

segments.arabic: وَ أمَرْتَ بِإقامَةِ الْحُدُودِ، وَ الطّاعَةِ لِلْمَعْبُودِ،
segments.transliteration: wa 'amarta bi'iqÄmatil Ä§udÅ«d, waÅ£-Å£Äati lil mabÅ«d,
segments.translation: ordered the establishment of the limits of divine law, and the obedience to the One Who should be worshipped,

segments.arabic: وَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الْخَبائِثِ وَ الطُّغْيانِ،
segments.translation: and forbade (people) from wickedness and oppression.
But, they confronted you with injustice and aggression.

segments.arabic: فَجاهَدْتَهُمْ بَعْدَ الإيعازِ لَهُمْ [الإيعادِ إلَيْهِمْ] وَ تَأْكيدِ الْحُجَّةِ عَلَيْهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: fa jÄhadtahum badal 'Ä«Äzi lahum [al-Ä«Ädi 'ilayhim] wa ta'kÄ«dil Ä§ujjati alayhim,
segments.translation: Therefore, you resisted them after advising them and stressing over (divine) proofs against them.
However, they violated your (divine) rights and oath.
angered your Lord and your grandfather,
and initiated battle against you.
Hence, you stood firm to spear and strike,

segments.arabic: وَ طَحَنْتَ جُنُودَ الْفُجّارِ، وَ اقْتَحَمْتَ قَسْطَلَ الْغُبارِ،
segments.transliteration: wa Å£aÄ§anta junÅ«dal fujjÄr, waqtaÄ§amta qasÅ£alal ghubÄr,
segments.translation: pulverized the soldiers of the transgressors, and stormed (courageously) into the dust of the battle,

segments.arabic: مُجالِداً بِذِى الْفَقارِ، كَأنَّكَ عَلِيٌّ الْمُخْتارُ،
segments.transliteration: mujÄlidan bidhil faqÄr, ka'annaka aliyunil mukhtÄr,
segments.translation: fighting with Thulfaqar[1]Â as if you were Ali, the chosen one.

segments.arabic: فَلَمّا رَأوْكَ ثابِتَ الْجاشِ، غَيْرَ خائِفٍ وَ لا خاشٍ،
segments.transliteration: fallammÄ ra'awka thÄbital jÄsh, ghayra khÄ'ifin wa lÄ khÄsh,
segments.translation: So when they saw you firm, fearless, and courageous,

segments.arabic: نَصَبُوا لَكَ غَوائِلَ مَكْرِهِمْ، وَ قاتَلُوكَ بِكَيْدِهِمْ وَ شَرِّهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: naÅ¡abÅ« laka ghawÄ'ila makrihim, wa qÄtaluka bikaydihim wa sharrihim,
segments.translation: they set up their most malicious deceptions against you, and fought you with their deceit and viciousness.

segments.arabic: وَ أمَرَ اللَّعينُ جُنُودَهُ، فَمَنَعُوكَ الْماءَ وَ وُرُودَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa 'amaral-laÄ«nu junÅ«dahu, famanaÅ«kal mÄ'a wa wurÅ«dah,
segments.translation: The accursed one (Umar Ibn Saâd) commanded his soldiers, and thus, they prevented you from reaching or receiving water.

segments.arabic: وَ ناجَزُوكَ الْقِتالَ، وَ عاجَلُوكَ النِّزالَ،
segments.translation: They rushed to engage you in combat, descended swiftly upon you,
showering you with arrows and stones,
and moving towards you with uprooting hands.

segments.arabic: وَ لَمْ يَرْعَوْا لَكَ ذِماماً، وَ لا راقَبُوا فيكَ أثاماً، في قَتْلِهِمْ أوْلِياءَكَ، وَ نَهْبِهِمْ رِحالَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam yaraw laka dhimÄmÄ, wa lÄ rÄqabÅ« fÄ«ka 'athÄmÄ, fÄ« qatlihim 'awliyÄ'ak, wa nahbihim riÄ§Älak,
segments.translation: Neither they respected your rights, nor were they mindful of retribution for slaying you and your companions, and plundering your belongings.

segments.arabic: وَ أنْتَ مُقَدَّمٌ فِي الْهَبَواتِ، وَ مُحْتَمِلٌ لِلأذِيّاتِ،
segments.transliteration: wa 'anta muqqaddamun fil habawÄt, wa muÄ§tamilun lil adhiyyÄt,
segments.translation: You were in the front line of the storm (of battle), enduring afflictions.

segments.arabic: قَدْ عَجِبَتْ مِنْ صَبْرِكَ مَلائِكَةُ السَّماواتِ،
segments.translation: Indeed, the angels of the heavens were astonished by your patience.
The enemy then surrounded you from all sides,
weakened you by inflicting wounds,

segments.arabic: وَ حالُوا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ الرَّواحِ،
segments.translation: prevented you from taking any repose,
and you had no helper remaining.
You were bereaved yet patient,
defending your women and children,
until they caused you to fall from your horse.
You fell to the ground, wounded,
horses trampled you with their hooves,
tyrants raised their swords against you,
the sweat of death appeared on your forehead,

segments.arabic: وَ اخْتَلَفَتْ بِالاِنْقِباضِ وَ الإنْبِساطِ شِمالُكَ وَ يَمينُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wakhtalafat bil inqibÄÄhi wal inbisÄÅ£i shimÄluka wa yamÄ«nuk,
segments.translation: and you continually clenched and unclenched your hands,

segments.arabic: تُديرُ طَرْفاً خَفِيّاً إلى رَحْلِكَ وَ بَيْتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: tudÄ«ru Å£arfan khafiyyan 'ilÄ raÄ§lika wa baytik,
segments.translation: secretly gazing upon your caravan and tents,

segments.arabic: وَ قَدْ شُغِلْتَ بِنَفْسِكَ عَنْ وُلْدِكَ وَ أهاليكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa qad shughilta binafsika an wuldika wa 'ahÄlÄ«k,
segments.translation: while trapped by yourself away from your children and family.

segments.arabic: وَ أسْرَعَ فَرَسُكَ شارِداً، إلى خِيامِكَ قاصِداً، مُحَمْحِماً باكِياً،
segments.transliteration: wa 'asraa farasuka shÄridan, 'ilÄ khiyÄmika qÄÅ¡idan, muÄ§amÄ§iman bÄkiyÄ,
segments.translation: (At that time,) your horse distractedly galloped towards your camp, neighing and crying.
When the women saw your horse distraught,
and observed your saddle contorted,
they came from the tents,
disheveling their hair,
striking their now unveiled cheeks,
calling you by lamenting and wailing,
being humiliated after being honored,
hastening to where you lay wounded.
At that time ShimrÂ (L)Â was sitting on your chest,
quenching his sword with (the blood of) your throat,
grabbing your beard with his hand,
as he slew you with his sword.
Your faculties faded,
your breath became shallow and ceased,
and your head was raised onto a spear.
Your family were captured like slaves,

segments.arabic: وَ صُفِّدُوا فِي الْحَديدِ فَوْقَ أقْتابِ الْمَطِيّاتِ،
segments.transliteration: wa Å¡uffidÅ« fil Ä§adÄ«di fawqa 'aqtÄbil maÅ£iyyÄt,
segments.translation: bound with iron chains atop camels,
with midday heat scorching their faces.
They were driven across deserts and wastelands,
with their hands chained to their necks,
and were paraded around the markets.
Woe be unto the wicked transgressors!
Certainly, by killing you, they have killed Islam,[1]
disrupted (the truth of) prayer and fasting,
revoked the (prophetic) customs and the (divine) laws,
destroyed the pillars of faith,
distorted the verses of the Quran,

segments.arabic: وَ هَمْلَجُوا فِي الْبَغْيِ وَ الْعُدْوانِ،
segments.transliteration: wa hamlajÅ« fil baghyi wal udwÄn,
segments.translation: and brutally rushed into tyranny and aggression.

segments.arabic: لَقَدْ أصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مَوْتُوراً،
segments.transliteration: laqad 'aÅ¡baÄ§a rasÅ«lul-lÄhi Å¡allal-lÄhu alayhi wa Älihi mawtÅ«rÄ,
segments.translation: Certainly, (by this event,) the Messenger of AllahÂ (PBUH&HF)was wronged, left alone, and denied vengeance,

segments.arabic: وَ عادَ كِتابُ اللهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ مَهْجُوراً،
segments.transliteration: wa Äda kitÄbul-lÄhi azza wa jalla mahjÅ«rÄ,
segments.translation: the Book of Allah, the mighty and the majestic, was again abandoned,

segments.arabic: وَ غُودِرَ الْحَقُّ إذْ قُهِرْتَ مَقْهُوراً،
segments.translation: truth was betrayed when you were forcibly overcome,

segments.arabic: وَ فُقِدَ بِفَقْدِكَ التَّكْبيرُ وَ التَّهْليلُ،
segments.translation: And with your loss, call for Allahâs glorification and His Unity,

segments.arabic: وَالتَّحْريمُ وَ التَّحْليلُ، وَ التَّنْزيلُ وَ التَّأْويلُ،
segments.translation: His prohibitions, sanctions, revelation, and interpretation were lost.

segments.arabic: وَ ظَهَرَ بَعْدَكَ التَّغْييرُ وَ التَّبْديلُ، وَ الإلْحادُ وَ التَّعْطيلُ، وَ الأهْواءُ وَ الأضاليلُ، وَ الْفِتَنُ وَ الأباطيلُ،
segments.transliteration: wa Äahara badakat-taghyÄ«ru wat-tabdÄ«l, wal 'ilÄ§Ädu wat-taÅ£Ä«l, wal 'ahwÄ'u wal 'aÄhÄlÄ«l, wal fitanu wal 'abÄÅ£Ä«l,
segments.translation: After you, alteration, distortion, infidelity, abandonment (of the Islamic laws), vagary, misguidance, turmoil and falsehood became prevalent.

segments.arabic: فَقامَ ناعيكَ عِنْدَ قَبْرِ جَدِّكَ الرَّسُولِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: faqÄma nÄÄ«ka inda qabri jaddikar-rasÅ«li, Å¡allal-lÄhu layhi wa Älih,
segments.translation: The announcer of your martyrdom came near the grave of your grandfather, the MessengerÂ (PBUH&HF),
gave the news to him with tears flowing, saying:

segments.arabic: يا رَسُولَ اللهِ، قُتِلَ سِبْطُكَ وَ فَتاكَ،
segments.transliteration: ya rasÅ«lal-lÄh, qutila sibÅ£uka wa fatÄk,
segments.translation: 0 the Messenger of Allah! Your brave grandson was slain,
and abuse of your family and supporters were deemed lawful.
After you, your progeny were captured,

segments.arabic: وَ وَقَعَ الْمَحْذُورُ بِعِتْرَتِكَ وَ ذَويكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa waqaal maÄ§dhÅ«ru biitratika wa dhawÄ«k,
segments.translation: and adversity befell your family and your offspring.

segments.arabic: فَانْزَعَجَ الرَّسُولُ، وَ بَكى قَلْبُهُ الْمَهُولُ،
segments.translation: Indeed, the MessengerÂ (PBUH&HF)Â became distressed and his depressed heart wept,

segments.arabic: وَ عَزّاهُ بِكَ الْمَلائِكَةُ وَ الأنْبِياءُ،
segments.translation: The Angels and the prophets offered their condolences to him for your martyrdom,
Your mother, al-Zahra, became distressed and bereft of you,

segments.arabic: وَ اخْتَلَفَتْ جُنُودُ الْمَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبينَ، تُعَزّي أباكَ أميرَالْمُؤْمِنينَ،
segments.transliteration: wakhtalafat junÅ«dul malÄ'ikatil muqarrabÄ«n, tuazzÄ« 'abÄka 'amÄ«ral mu'minÄ«n,
segments.translation: Legions of favored Angels came in waves to offer their condolences to your father, the Leader of the Faithful,

segments.arabic: وَ اُقيمَتْ لَكَ الْمَآتِمُ في أعْلا عِلِّيّينَ،
segments.translation: Mourning commemorations were held for you in the utmost exalted place Heaven,
and the dark-eyed Maidens (ofÂ Paradise) hit their own heads and faces in grief,
The skies and their inhabitants wept,
as didÂ ParadiseÂ and its keepers,
the mountains and their surroundings,
the oceans and their fishes,
the heavens and their servants,
the House (Kaâba), and the Station (of Abraham),
the Sacred Monument,
andÂ MeccaÂ and its sanctuary.
O Allah! By the sanctity of this exalted place (the tomb of Imam al-HusainÂ (PBUH)),

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: Å¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammad,
segments.translation: bestow blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
assemble me in their company,
and admit me toÂ ParadiseÂ by their intercession.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي أتَوَسَّلُ إلَيْكَ يا أسْرَعَ الْحاسِبينَ،
segments.translation: My Allah! I implore You, O He who is the quickest of the reckoners!

segments.arabic: وَ ياأكْرَمَ الأكْرَمينَ، وَ ياأحْكَمَ الْحاكِمينَ،
segments.translation: O the most generous of the generous and the wisest of judges!

segments.arabic: بِمُحَمَّدٍ خاتَمِ النَّبِيّينَ، رَسُولِكَ إلَى الْعالَمينَ أجْمَعينَ،
segments.translation: By Muhammad, the seal of the prophets, Your Messenger to all the worlds,

segments.arabic: وَ بِأخيهِ وَ ابْنِ عَمِّهِ الأنْزَعِ الْبَطينِ، الْعالِمِ الْمَكينِ، عَلِيٍّ أميرِ الْمُؤْمِنينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa bi 'akhÄ«hi wabni ammihil 'anzail baÅ£Ä«n, al-Älimil makÄ«n, aliyyin 'amÄ«ril mu'minÄ«n,
segments.translation: By his brother and cousin, the uprooter of hidden polytheism, the distinguished and learned, Ali, the Prince of the Faithful,

segments.transliteration: wa bi fÄÅ£imata sayyidati nisÄ'il ÄlamÄ«n,
segments.translation: By Fatima, the chief of women of the worlds,
By al-Hasan, the purified one and the protection of the pious,

segments.arabic: وَ بِأبي عَبْدِاللهِ الْحُسَيْنِ أكْرَمِ الْمُسْتَشْهَدينَ،
segments.translation: By Abi Abdillah, al-Husain, the most honored martyr,

segments.arabic: وَ بِأوْلادِهِ الْمَقْتُولينَ، وَ بِعِتْرَتِهِ الْمَظْلُومينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa bi-'awlÄdihil maqtÅ«lÄ«n wa bi itratihil maÄlÅ«mÄ«n,
segments.translation: By his slain children and oppressed family,

segments.arabic: وَ بِعَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ زَيْنِ الْعابِدينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa bi aliyyibnil Ä§usayni zaynil ÄbidÄ«n,
segments.translation: By Ali Ibn al-Husain, the ornament of the worshippers,

segments.arabic: وَ بِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ قِبْلَةِ الأوّابينَ،
segments.translation: By Muhammad Ibn Ali, the direction of those who turn to Allah,

segments.arabic: وَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ أصْدَقِ الصّادِقينَ،
segments.translation: By Jaâfar Ibn Muhammad, the most truthful,

segments.arabic: وَ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ مُظْهِرِ الْبَراهينَ،
segments.translation: By Musa Ibn Jaâfar, the discloser of the proofs,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسى ناصِرِ الدّينِ،
segments.translation: By Ali Ibn Musa, the helper of the religion,

segments.arabic: وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ قُدْوَةِ الْمُهْتَدينَ،
segments.translation: By Muhammad Ibn Ali, the exemplar of those who accepted guidance,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ أزْهَدِ الزّاهِدينَ،
segments.translation: By Ali Ibn Muhammad, the most ascetic,

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ وارِثِ الْمُسْتَخْلَفينَ،
segments.translation: By Hasan Ibn Ali, the inheritor of the appointed ones,
By the Proof upon all creation (al-Mahdi),

segments.arabic: أنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: 'an tuÅ¡alliya alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammad,
segments.translation: Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: الصّادِقينَ الأبَرّينَ، آلِ طه وَ يس،
segments.translation: the most truthful and devoted ones (who are) the family ofTahaÂ andÂ Yasin,[1]

segments.arabic: وَ أنْ تَجْعَلَني فِي الْقِيامَةِ مِنَ الآمِنينَ الْمُطْمَئِنّينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa 'an tajalani fil qiyÄmati minal ÄminÄ«nal muÅ£ma'innÄ«n,
segments.translation: and place me on the Day of Judgment among those who are safe, confident,
triumphant, happy, and felicitous.
O Allah! Destine me to be amongst the submitters,
Join me with the righteous,[1]

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لي لِسانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الآخِرينَ،
segments.transliteration: wajal lÄ« lisÄna Å¡idqin fil ÄkhirÄ«n,
segments.translation: Ordain for me (offspring with) truthful tongue among the last generation,[2]
Make me victorious over the transgressors,
Suffice me the deception of the envious,
Turn away from me the evil plans of the schemers,
Hold back from me the hands of the oppressors,

segments.arabic: وَاجْمَعْ بَيْني وَ بَيْنَ السّادَةِ الْمَيامينِ في أعْلا عِلِّيّينَ،
segments.transliteration: wajma baynÄ« wa baynas-sÄdatil mayÄmÄ«ni fÄ« 'alÄ illiyyÄ«n,
segments.translation: Gather me with the blessed masters in the utmost exalted place of Heaven,

segments.arabic: مَعَ الَّذينَ أنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيّينَ وَ الصِّدّيقينَ وَ الشُّهَداءِ وَ الصّالِحينَ،
segments.transliteration: maal-ladhÄ«na 'anamta alayhim minal nabiyyÄ«na waÅ¡-Å¡iddÄ«qÄ«na wash-shuhadÄ'i waÅ¡-Å¡ÄliÄ§Ä«n,
segments.translation: along with whom You have bestowed favor, from among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous,[]
By Your mercy, O the most merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي اُقْسِمُ عَلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ الْمَعْصُومِ،
segments.translation: O Allah! I implore You by Your infallible Prophet,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحُكْمِكَ الْمَحْتُومِ، وَ نُهْيَكَ [نَهْيِكَ] الْمَكْتُومِ،
segments.transliteration: wa biÄ§ukmikal maÄ§tÅ«m, wa nuhyakal maktÅ«m,
segments.translation: by Your definite judgment, and Your concealed preventive wisdom,

segments.arabic: وَ بِهذَا الْقَبْرِ الْمَلْمُومِ، الْمُوَسَّدِ في كَنَفِهِ الإمامُ الْمَعْصُومُ، الْمَقْتُولُ الْمَظْلُومُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bihÄdhal qabril malmÅ«m, al-muwassadi fÄ« kanafihil 'imÄmul maÅ¡Å«m, al-maqtÅ«lul maÄlÅ«m,
segments.translation: by this grave which is the place of congregation and in which lies the infallible Imam, the slaughtered, and the oppressed,

segments.arabic: أنْ تَكْشِفَ ما بي مِنَ الْغُمُومِ،
segments.translation: that You dispel from me all that grieves me,

segments.arabic: وَ تَصْرِفَ عَنّي شَرَّ الْقَدَرِ الْمَحْتُومِ،
segments.transliteration: wa taÅ¡rifa annÄ« sharral qadaril maÄ§tÅ«m,
segments.translation: divert from me the harm of the decisive foreordained plan,

segments.arabic: وَ تُجيرَني مِنَ النّارِ ذاتِ السَّمُومِ،
segments.translation: and give me refuge from the Hellfire with scorching winds.
My Allah! Honor me with Your bounties,
Make me content with Your apportionment,
Encompass me with Your munificence and generosity,

segments.arabic: وَ باعِدْني مِنْ مَكْرِكَ وَ نِقْمَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa bÄidnÄ« min makrika wa niqmatik,
segments.translation: And keep me far off from Your requital scheme and Your wrath.
O Allah! Protect me from errors,

segments.arabic: وَ سدِّدْني فِي الْقَوْلِ وَ الْعَمَلِ،
segments.transliteration: wa saddidnÄ« fil qawli wal amal,
segments.translation: Make me firm in speech and action,
Extend for me the period (of life),

segments.arabic: وَ اعْفِني مِنَ الأوْجاعِ وَ الْعِلَلِ،
segments.translation: Relieve me from pain and ailments,

segments.arabic: وَ بَلِّغْني بِمَوالِيَّ وَ بِفَضْلِكَ أفْضَلَ الأَمَلِ،
segments.translation: Make me achieve, through my masters and Your grace, the best of wishes.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اقْبَلْ تَوْبَتي،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma Å¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammad waqbal tawbati,
segments.translation: O Allah! Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and accept my repentance and my return,
Have mercy upon my weeping,
Lessen my lapses,
Relieve my distress,
Forgive me my mistake,
And improve my (righteousness) through my children.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ لا تَدَعْ لي في هذَا الْمَشْهَدِ الْمُعَظَّمِ وَ الْمَحَلِّ الْمُكَرَّمِ ذَنْباً إلاّ غَفَرْتَهُ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma lÄ tada lÄ« fÄ« hÄdhal mash-hadil muaÄÄami wal maÄ§allil mukkarrami dhanban 'illÄ ghafartah,
segments.translation: My Allah! Do not leave for me, in this exalted and honored place of martyrdom, any sin but that You forgive,
Nor any defect but that You conceal,
Nor any grief but that You remove,
Nor any sustenance but that You extend,
Nor any (spiritual) status but that You cause to prosper,
Nor any corruption but that which You correct,
Nor any wish but that You fulfill,
Nor any supplication but that You answer,
Nor any pressure but that You relieve,
Nor any dispersed (believers) but that You reunify,
Nor any matter but that You complete,
Nor any wealth but that You increase,
Nor any character but that You improve,
Nor any charity but that You repay,
Nor any condition but that You cause to improve,
Nor any envious (one) but that You suppress,
Nor any enemy but that You destroy,
Nor any evil but that You suffice,
Nor any ailment but that You cure,
Nor any distant (one) but that You bring near,
Nor any scattering but that You reunite,
Nor any request but that You grant.
O Allah! I ask You for the goodness of this transitory world,
and the reward of the hereafter.
O Allah! Suffice me with what You made lawful from the unlawful,
and with Your grace from all other creatures.
My Allah! I ask You for beneficial knowledge,
a humble heart,
unequivocal certitude,
pure action,
beautiful patience,
and a bountiful reward.
O Allah! Grant me gratitude of Your blessing upon me,

segments.arabic: وَ زِدْ في إحْسانِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ إلَىَّ،
segments.translation: Increase Your favor and munificence on me,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ قَوْلي فِي النّاسِ مَسْمُوعاً،
segments.translation: Make my speech amongst people effective,
my deeds elevated and worthy of being delivered to You,
my righteous works followed (by others),
and my enemy quelled,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الأخْيارِ، في آناءِ اللَّيْلِ وَ أطْرافِ النَّهارِ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma Å¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammadinil 'akhyÄr, fÄ« ÄnÄ'il-layli wa 'aÅ£rÄfin-nahÄr,
segments.translation: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, the best of the creations, day and night,
Spare me from the evil of the wicked,

segments.arabic: وَ طَهِّرْني مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَ الأوْزارِ،
segments.translation: Purify me from sins and burdens,
Give me refuge from Hell-fire,
Settle me in the House of rest (Paradise),

segments.arabic: وَ اغْفِرْ لي وَ لِجَميعِ إخْواني فيكَ وَ أخَواتِيَ الْمُؤْمِنينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِناتِ،
segments.transliteration: waghfir lÄ« wa lijamÄ«i 'ikhwÄni fÄ«ka wa 'akhawÄtiyal mu'minÄ«na wal mu'minÄt,
segments.translation: And forgive me and all my faithful brothers and sisters,
By Your mercy, O the most merciful of the merciful!
There is no deity but Allah, the forbearing, the generous.
There is no deity but Allah, the supreme, the great.

segments.arabic: لاإلهَ إلاَّاللهُ رَبُّ السَّماواتِ السَّبْعِ وَ الأرَضينَ السَّبْعِ،
segments.translation: There is no deity but Allah, the Lord of the seven heavens and the seven earths,

segments.arabic: وَ ما فيهِنَّ وَ ما بَيْنَهُنَّ،
segments.transliteration: wa mÄ fÄ«hinna wa mÄ baynahunn,
segments.translation: and whatever is in them and whatever is between them.
(By this, I am) opposing (the belief of) His enemies,
disavowing whomever has turned away from Him,
confessing His Lordship,
and surrendering to His majesty.
He is the first other than being the first (in number).
He is the last without having an end.
He is dominant (Zahir) over everything by His power.

segments.arabic: الْباطِنُ دُونَ كُلِّ شَىْء بِعِلْمِهِ وَ لُطْفِهِ،
segments.transliteration: al-bÄÅ£inu dÅ«na kulli shay'in biilmihi wa luÅ£fih,
segments.translation: He is hidden (Batin) as He knows underneath of every thing by His knowledge and His subtlety.

segments.arabic: لا تَقِفُ الْعُقُولُ عَلى كُنْهِ عَظَمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: lÄ taqiful uqÅ«lu alÄ kunhi aÄamatih,
segments.translation: Intellects cannot comprehend the depth of His grandeur.

segments.arabic: وَ لا تُدْرِكُ الأوْهامُ حَقيقَةَ ماهِيَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: Thoughts cannot grasp the reality of His Essence.

segments.arabic: وَ لا تَتَصَوَّرُ الأنْفُسُ مَعانِيَ كَيْفِيَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: Souls cannot imagine the meanings of His (created) qualities.
He knows well the innermost thoughts (of His servants),
is cognizant of the secrets,

segments.arabic: يَعْلَمُ خائِنَةَ الأعْيُنِ وَ ما تُخْفِى الصُّدُورُ،
segments.translation: and knows the treachery of the eyes, and all that the hearts (of men) conceal.[1]

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي اُشْهِدُكَ عَلى تَصْديقي رَسُولَكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ إيماني بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma 'innÄ« 'ush-hiduka alÄ taÅ¡dÄ«qÄ« rasÅ«laka Å¡allal-lÄhu layhi wa Älih wa 'Ä«mÄnÄ« bih,
segments.translation: My Allah! I bear You as witness of my acknowledgement of Your MessengerÂ (PBUH&HF)Â and my faith in him,
and my recognition of his status.

segments.arabic: وَ إنّي أشْهَدُ أنَّهُ النَّبِيُّ الَّذي نَطَقَتِ الْحِكْمَةُ بِفَضْلِهِ،
segments.translation: I bear witness that he was the Prophet by whose favor wisdom was given voice,
of whom (previous) prophets gave glad tidings,

segments.arabic: وَ دَعَتْ إلَى الإقْرارِ بِما جاءَ بِهِ،
segments.translation: called people to admit what heÂ  brought (from the Lord),
and urged people to acknowledge him,

segments.arabic: بِقَوْلِهِ تَعالى: «اَلَّذي يَجِدُونَهُ مَكْتُوباً عِنْدَهُمْ فِي التَّوْريةِ وَ الإنْجيلِ يَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ يَنْهيهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَ يُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّباتِ وَ يُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبائِثَ وَ يَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إصْرَهُمْ وَ الأغْلالَ الَّتي كانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ»،
segments.transliteration: biqawlihi ta'ÄlÄ: alladhÄ«na yajidÅ«nahu maktÅ«ban indahum fit-tawrÄti wal 'injÄ«li ya'muruhum bil marÅ«fi wa yanhÄhum anil munkari wa yuÄ§illu lahumuÅ£-Å£ayyibÄti wa yuÄ§arrimu alayhimul khabÄ'itha wa yaÄhau anhum 'iÅ¡rahum wal 'aghlÄlal-lati kÄnat
segments.translation: according to His saying, the most high,Â ââ¦ he, whom they find mentioned in their Torah and the Gospels, who commands them virtuous acts and forbids them evil, allows them as lawful the good (and pure) things, prohibits them from impurities, and releases them from their heavy burdens and from the yokes that are upon them ...âÂ [2]

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِكَ إلَى الثَّقَلَيْنِ،
segments.translation: Thus, bless Muhammad, Your messenger to both masses (of human and Jinn),
the master of the chosen prophets,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلى أخيهِ وَ ابْنِ عَمِّهِ،
segments.translation: and (bless) his brother and his cousin,

segments.arabic: اللَّذَيْنِ لَمْ يُشْرِكا بِكَ طَرْفَةَ عَيْن أبَداً،
segments.transliteration: alladhÄ«na lam yushrikÄ bika Å£arfata aynin 'abadÄ,
segments.translation: neither of whom ever took associates with You (in worship) even for one moment,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلى فاطِمَةَ الزَّهْراءِ سَيِّدةِ نِساءِ الْعالَمينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa alÄ fÄÅ£imataz-zahrÄ'i sayyidati nisÄ'il ÄlamÄ«n,
segments.translation: and (bless) Fatima, the radiant, and the chief of the ladies of the worlds,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلى سَيِّدَىْ شَبابِ أهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ،
segments.transliteration: wa alÄ sayyiday shabÄbi 'ahlil jannah, al-Ä§asani wal Ä§usayn,
segments.translation: and (bless) the two masters of the youth ofÂ Paradise, al-Hasan and al-Husain,
With an everlasting blessing,
equal to the number of drops of rains,
and the weight of the mountains and hills,
until peace and salutations is ever exchanged,
and brightness (of day) and darkness (of night) are replaced.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلى آلِهِ الطّاهِرينَ، الأئِمَّةِ الْمُهْتَدينَ،
segments.translation: And (bless) his pure family, (the rest of) the guided Imams,
the defenders of the religion,

segments.arabic: عَلِيٍّ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ جَعْفَرٍ وَ مُوسى وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُجَّةِ،
segments.transliteration: aliyyin wa muÄ§ammadin wa jafarin wa mÅ«sa wa aliyyin wa muÄ§ammadin wa aliyyin wal Ä§asani wal Ä§ujjah,
segments.translation: (who are) Ali, Muhammad, Jaâfar, Musa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, al-Hasan, and al-Hujja,
the establishers of fairness, and the grandsons of the Prophet(PBUH&HF).

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي أسْئَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هذَا الإمامِ فَرَجاً قَريباً،
segments.translation: O Allah! I ask You by the rights of this Imam, a relief in the near future,
beautiful patience,
mighty triumph,
sufficiency from people,
steadfastness in (the path of) guidance,

segments.arabic: وَ التَّوْفيقَ لِما تُحِبُّ وَ تَرْضى،
segments.translation: success in what pleases and satisfies You,
a sustenance that is vast, lawful, pure,
adequate, fruitful, pleasant,
abundant, superior, pouring forth,

segments.arabic: مِنْ غَيْرِ كَدّ وَ لا نَكَد، وَ لا مِنَّة مِنْ أحَد،
segments.transliteration: min ghayri kaddin wa lÄ nakad, wa lÄ minnatin min 'aÄ§ad,
segments.translation: without any toil, trouble, and favor from anyone.

segments.arabic: وَ عافِيَةً مِنْ كُلِّ بَلاء وَ سُقْم وَ مَرَض،
segments.transliteration: wa Äfiyatan min kulli balÄ'in wa suqmin wa maraÄh,
segments.translation: Preserve my health against any affliction, ailment, and disease,

segments.arabic: وَ الشُّكْرَ عَلَى الْعافِيَةِ وَ النَّعْماءِ،
segments.translation: Grant me appreciation of well-being and blessings,

segments.arabic: وَ إذا جاءَ الْمَوْتُ فَاقْبِضْنا عَلى أحْسَنِ ما يَكُونُ لَكَ طاعَةً،
segments.transliteration: wa 'idhÄ jÄ'al mawtu faqbidhnÄ alÄ 'aÄ§sani mÄ yakÅ«nu laka Å£Ä'ah,
segments.translation: And when the time of death arrives, take our soul while it is in the best condition of obedience to You,

segments.arabic: عَلى ما أمَرْتَنا مُحافِظينَ حَتّى تُؤَدِّيَنا إلى جَنّاتِ النَّعيمِ،
segments.transliteration: alÄ mÄ 'amartanÄ muÄ§ÄfiÄhÄ«na Ä§attÄ Å£u'addiyanÄ 'ilÄ jannÄtin-naÄ«m,
segments.translation: And while observing what You commanded, so that You lead us to the Garden of blessings.
By Your mercy, O the most merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma Å¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammad,
segments.translation: My Allah! Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: wa 'awÄ§ishnÄ« minad-dunyÄ wa ÄnisnÄ« bil Äkhirah,
segments.translation: and estrange me from (the attractions of) the world, and make me familiar with (the affairs of) the hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَإنَّهُ لا يُوحِشُ مِنَ الدُّنْيا إلاّ خَوْفُكَ،
segments.translation: Certainly, nothing causes alienation from this world except fear of You,

segments.arabic: وَ لا يُؤْنِسُ بِالآخِرَةِ إلاّ رَجآؤُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yu'nisu bil Äkhirati 'illÄ rajÄ'uk,
segments.translation: and nothing causes to be accustomed to the hereafter except hope for Your (mercy).
O Allah! For You is the argument, not against You,
and to You is complained, not from You.
Thus, bless Muhammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَ أعِنّي عَلى نَفْسِيَ الظّالِمَةِ الْعاصِيَةِ،
segments.translation: and assist me against my unjust and disobedient soul,
and my dominant desire.
And conclude me with a safe and healthy end.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّ اسْتِغْفاري إيّاكَ وَ أنَا مُصِرٌّ عَلى مانَهَيْتَ قِلَّةُ حَيآء،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma 'innastighfÄrÄ« 'iyyÄka wa 'ana muÅ¡irrun alÄ mÄ nahayta qillatu Ä§ayÄ',
segments.translation: O Allah! It is due to my shamelessness that I ask forgiveness while I insist on what You have forbidden.

segments.arabic: وَ تَرْكِيَ الاِسْتِغْفارَ مَعَ عِلْمي بِسِعَةِ حِلْمِكَ تَضْييعٌ لِحَقِّ الرَّجآءِ،
segments.transliteration: wa tarkiyal 'istighfÄra maa ilmÄ« bisiati Ä§ilmika taÄhyÄ«'un liÄ§aqqir-rajÄ'
segments.translation: On the other hand, if I do not ask for forgiveness with my knowledge of Your abundant forbearance, it will be wasting the right of hope (to You).

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّ ذُنُوبي تُؤْيِسُني أنْ أرْجُوَكَ،
segments.translation: My Allah! (due to my weak faith) my sins discourage me from requesting You,

segments.arabic: وَ إنَّ عِلْمي بِسِعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ يَمْنَعُني أنْ أخْشاكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa inna ilmi bisiati rahmatika yamnaunÄ« 'an 'akhshÄk,
segments.translation: and my knowledge about Your vast mercy prevents me from fearing You.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: faÅ¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammad,
segments.translation: Thus, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
and confirm my hope in You,
negate my fear of You,

segments.arabic: وَ كُنْ لي عِنْدَ أحْسَنِ ظَنّي بِكَ يا أكْرَمَ الأكْرَمينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa kun lÄ« inda 'aÄ§sani Äanni bika yÄ 'akramal 'akramÄ«n
segments.translation: and be for me according to the best of what I expect and believe about You, O the most generous of the generous!

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أيِّدْني بِالْعِصْمَةِ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma Å¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammadin, wa 'ayyidnÄ« bil iÅ¡mah,
segments.translation: O Allah! Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and support me by protection (from sins),
Make my tongue speak wisdom,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْني مِمَّنْ يَنْدَمُ عَلى ما ضَيَّعَهُ في أمْسِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wajalnÄ« mimman yandamu alÄ mÄ Ähayyaahu fÄ« 'amsih,
segments.translation: Place me among those who regret what they wasted yesterday,

segments.arabic: وَ لا يَغْبَنُ حَظَّهُ في يَوْمِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yaghbanu Ä§aÄÄahu fÄ« yawmih,
segments.translation: do not aggrieve their portion today,
and do not worry about the sustenance of tomorrow.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّ الْغَنِيَّ مَنِ اسْتَغْنى بِكَ وَ افْتَقَرَ إلَيْكَ،
segments.translation: O Allah! Certainly, rich is he who suffices himself with You and considers himself in need of You,

segments.arabic: وَ الْفَقيرَ مَنِ اسْتَغْنى بِخَلْقِكَ عَنْكَ،
segments.translation: and poor is he who feels that he can suffice himself through Your creation without You.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: faÅ¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammad,
segments.translation: Thus, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
and suffice me from Your creation by Yourself,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْني مِمَّنْ لا يَبْسُطُ كَفّاً إلاّ إلَيْكَ،
segments.translation: and put me amongst those who do not extend their hand except towards You.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّ الشَّقِيَّ مَنْ قَنَطَ وَ أمامَهُ التَّوْبَةُ وَ وَرآءَهُ الرَّحْمَةُ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma 'innash-shaqiyya man qanaÅ£a wa 'amÄmahut-tawbatu wa warÄ'ahur-rahmah,
segments.translation: My Allah! Certainly, wretched is he who despairs while repentance is placed before him and mercy is after him,

segments.arabic: وَ إنْ كُنْتُ ضَعيفَ الْعَمَلِ فَإ نّي في رَحْمَتِكَ قَوِيُّ الأمَلِ،
segments.transliteration: wa 'in kuntu ÄhaÄ«fal amali fa 'innÄ« fÄ« raÄ§matika qawiyyal 'amal,
segments.translation: Even though I have been weak in action, I have strong hope in Your mercy,

segments.arabic: فَهَبْ لي ضَعْفَ عَمَلي لِقُوَّةِ أمَلي،
segments.translation: Thus, forgive the weakness of my action in light of the strength of my hope.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أنْ ما في عِبادِكَ مَنْ هُوَ أقْسى قَلْباً مِنّي وَ أعْظَمُ مِنّي ذَنْباً،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma 'in kunta talamu 'an mÄ fÄ« 'ibÄdika man huwa 'aqsÄ qalban minnÄ« wa 'aÄamu minnÄ« dhanbÄ,
segments.translation: O Allah! Even if You know there is no one amongst Your servants with harder heart and greater sins than mine,

segments.arabic: فَإ نّي أعْلَمُ أنَّهُ لا مَوْلى أعْظَمُ مِنْكَ طَوْلا،
segments.translation: I certainly know that there is no master more generous than You,
with greater mercy and forgiveness.

segments.arabic: فَيا مَنْ هُوَ أوْحَدُ في رَحْمَتِهِ،
segments.translation: Then, O He Who is unique in His mercy!

segments.arabic: إغْفِرْ لِمَنْ لَيْسَ بِأوْحَدَ في خَطيئَتِهِ،
segments.translation: Forgive him, who is not unique in his mistakes.
O Allah! Certainly, You commanded us, but we have disobeyed,
forbade us, but we did not desist,
reminded us, but we remained unmindful,
enlightened us, but we behaved blindly,
and warned us, but we transgressed.

segments.arabic: وَ ما كانَ ذلِكَ جَزآءَ إحْسانِكَ إلَيْنا،
segments.translation: This was not the repayment of Your kindness to us,

segments.arabic: وَ أنْتَ أعْلَمُ بِما أعْلَنّا وَ أخْفَيْنا،
segments.translation: and You know what we have disclosed and have concealed,

segments.arabic: وَ أخْبَرُ بِما نَأْتي وَ ما أتَيْنا،
segments.translation: and You are aware of what we will do and have done.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: faÅ¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammad,
segments.translation: Thus, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَ لا تُؤاخِذْنا بِما أخْطَأْنا وَ نَسينا،
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ tu'ÄkhidhnÄ bimÄ 'akhta'nÄ wa nasÄ«nÄ,
segments.translation: and pardon us for our mistakes and our forgetfulness,
forgive us the negligence of Your rights by us,
complete Your beneficence towards us,
and cause Your mercy to descend upon us.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إلَيْكَ بِهذَا الصِّدّيقِ الإمامِ،
segments.translation: My Allah! We seek nearness to You by means of this truthful Imam,

segments.arabic: وَ نَسْئَلُكَ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذي جَعَلْتَةُ لَهُ وَ لِجَدِّهِ رَسُولِكَ وَ لِأبَوَيْهِ عَلِيٍّ وَ فاطِمَةَ، أهْلِ بَيْتِ الرَّحْمَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa nas'aluka bil Ä§aqqil-ladhi jaaltahu lah wa lijaddihi rasÅ«lika wa li 'abawayhi aliyyin wa fÄÅ£imata 'ahli baytir-raÄ§mah,
segments.translation: and request You by the rights that You have placed for him, his grandfather, his parents, Ali and Fatima, the household of mercy,

segments.arabic: إدْرارَ الرِّزْقِ الَّذي بِهِ قِوامُ حَياتِنا وَ صَلاحُ أحْوالِ عِيالِنا،
segments.transliteration: 'idrÄrar-rizqil-lladhi bihÄ« qiwÄmu Ä§ayÄtinÄ, wa Å¡alÄÄ§u 'aÄ§wÄli iyÄlinÄ,
segments.translation: an abundant flow of livelihood that maintains our life and the welfare of our dependents.

segments.arabic: فَأنْتَ الْكَريمُ الَّذي تُعْطي مِنْ سِعَةٍ،
segments.translation: Certainly You are the generous one who grants abundantly,
and holds back having power (to fulfill).

segments.arabic: وَ نَحْنُ نَسْئَلُكَ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ مايَكُونُ صَلاحاً لِلدُّنْيا وَ بَلاغاً لِلآخِرَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa naÄ§nu nas'aluka minar-rizqi mÄ yakÅ«nu Å¡alÄhan liddunyÄ wa balÄghan lil Äkhirah,
segments.translation: We request from You a livelihood that brings the goodness of this world and the pleasure of the hereafter,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma Å¡alli alÄ muÄ§ammadin wa Äli muÄ§ammad,
segments.translation: O Allah! Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
and forgive me, my parents,
all the believing men and women,
and the submissive men and women,
the living of them and the dead.

segments.arabic: وَ آتِنا فِي الدُّنْيا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنا عَذابَ النّارِ.
segments.transliteration: wa ÄtinÄ fid-dunyÄ Ä§asanatan wa fil Äkhirati Ä§asanatan wa qinÄ adhÄban-nÄr.
segments.translation: Give us good in this world and good in the hereafter, and shield us from the torment of the fire.[1]

segments.arabic: سُبْحانَ اللهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ للهِِ وَ لا إلهَ إلاَّ اللهُ وَ اللهُ أكْبَرُ
segments.transliteration: subÄ§Änal-lÄhi wal Ä§amdulil-lÄhi wa lÄ 'ilÄha 'illal-lÄhu wal-lÄhu akbar,
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah! Praise be to Allah! There is no deity but Allah! Allah is greater (than being described).

segments.arabic: زادَ اللهُ في شَرَفِكُمْ، وَ السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكاتُهُ.
segments.transliteration: zÄdal-lÄhu fÄ« sharafikum, was-salÄmu alaykum wa raÄ§matul-lÄhi wa barakÄtuh.
segments.translation: May Allah increase your honor. Peace be upon you, the mercy of Allah, and His blessings.

From the lineage of the finest progeny
From the descendants of Abraham, the Friend [of God].

segments.arabic: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ.
segments.transliteration: á¹¢allÄ AllÄhu Ê¿alayka wa Ê¿alÄ abÄ«ka.

segments.arabic: يَا بُنَيَّ، مَا أَجْرَأَهُمْ عَلَى الرَّحْمَنِ.

The son of Munqidh ibn al-NuÊ¿man al-Ê¿AbdÄ«.

segments.translation: Peace be upon you, and the mercy and blessings of Allah.

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ الطِّفْلِ الرَّضِيعِ
segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alÄ Ê¿AbdillÄh ibn al-á¸¤usayn aá¹­-á¹­ifl ar-raá¸Ä«Ê¿

The one thrown down, slain, and soaked in blood.

Slaughtered by an arrow in his fatherâs lap,

Struck both advancing and retreating,

segments.translation: Peace be upon al-Ê¿AbbÄs, son of the Commander of the Faithful
Who supported his brother with his soul
Who took his courage and resolved it for him

segments.translation: The one who sacrificed for him, protected him, and brought him water.

segments.transliteration: YazÄ«d ibn ar-RaqÄd al-á¸¤aytÄ« wa á¸¤akÄ«m ibn aá¹­-á¹¬ufayl aá¹­-á¹¬ÄÊ¾Ä«.
segments.translation: YazÄ«d ibn ar-RaqÄd al-á¸¤aytÄ« and á¸¤akÄ«m ibn aá¹­-á¹¬ufayl aá¹­-á¹¬ÄÊ¾Ä«.

segments.translation: Who patiently endured, seeking Allahâs reward, and lived away from his homeland as a stranger
Who submitted to battle and stepped forward to combat.

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad ibn AmÄ«r al-MuÊ¾minÄ«n,
segments.translation: Peace be upon Muá¸¥ammad, son of the Commander of the Faithful
Slain by the DÄrmÄ« lineage,

segments.arabic:
السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَوَّلَ قَتِيلٍ مِنْ نَسْلِ خَيْرِ سَلِيلٍ مِنْ سُلَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْخَلِيلِ

بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مَاثِلًا وَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ قَائِلًا
